pokemon.Pokedex: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

pokemon.Name: Bronzong
pokemon.Pokedex: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

pokemon.Name: Bonsly
pokemon.Pokedex: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body's fluid levels by eliminating excess.

pokemon.Name: Mime Jr.
pokemon.Pokedex: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

pokemon.Name: Happiny
pokemon.Pokedex: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of Chansey.

pokemon.Name: Chatot
pokemon.Pokedex: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

pokemon.Name: Spiritomb
pokemon.Pokedex: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

pokemon.Name: Gible
pokemon.Pokedex: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

pokemon.Name: Gabite
pokemon.Pokedex: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.

pokemon.Name: Garchomp
pokemon.Pokedex: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

pokemon.Name: Munchlax
pokemon.Pokedex: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.

pokemon.Name: Riolu
pokemon.Pokedex: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

pokemon.Name: Lucario
pokemon.Pokedex: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

pokemon.Name: Hippopotas
pokemon.Pokedex: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.

pokemon.Name: Hippowdon
pokemon.Pokedex: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

pokemon.Name: Skorupi
pokemon.Pokedex: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

pokemon.Name: Drapion
pokemon.Pokedex: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

pokemon.Name: Croagunk
pokemon.Pokedex: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

pokemon.Name: Toxicroak
pokemon.Pokedex: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

pokemon.Name: Carnivine
pokemon.Pokedex: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

pokemon.Name: Finneon
pokemon.Pokedex: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

pokemon.Name: Lumineon
pokemon.Pokedex: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

pokemon.Name: Mantyke
pokemon.Pokedex: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.

pokemon.Name: Snover
pokemon.Pokedex: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

pokemon.Name: Abomasnow
pokemon.Pokedex: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

pokemon.Name: Weavile
pokemon.Pokedex: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

pokemon.Name: Magnezone
pokemon.Pokedex: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

pokemon.Name: Lickilicky
pokemon.Pokedex: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

pokemon.Name: Rhyperior
pokemon.Pokedex: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.

pokemon.Name: Tangrowth
pokemon.Pokedex: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

pokemon.Name: Electivire
pokemon.Pokedex: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

pokemon.Name: Magmortar
pokemon.Pokedex: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

pokemon.Name: Togekiss
pokemon.Pokedex: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.

pokemon.Name: Yanmega
pokemon.Pokedex: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

pokemon.Name: Leafeon
pokemon.Pokedex: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.

pokemon.Name: Glaceon
pokemon.Pokedex: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.

pokemon.Name: Gliscor
pokemon.Pokedex: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

pokemon.Name: Mamoswine
pokemon.Pokedex: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.

pokemon.Name: Porygon-Z
pokemon.Pokedex: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.

pokemon.Name: Gallade
pokemon.Pokedex: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

pokemon.Name: Probopass
pokemon.Pokedex: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.

pokemon.Name: Dusknoir
pokemon.Pokedex: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

pokemon.Name: Froslass
pokemon.Pokedex: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.

pokemon.Name: Rotom
pokemon.Pokedex: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

pokemon.Name: Uxie
pokemon.Pokedex: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

pokemon.Name: Mesprit
pokemon.Pokedex: Known as "The Being of Emotion." It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

pokemon.Name: Azelf
pokemon.Pokedex: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

pokemon.Name: Dialga
pokemon.Pokedex: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

pokemon.Name: Palkia
pokemon.Pokedex: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

pokemon.Name: Heatran
pokemon.Pokedex: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

pokemon.Name: Regigigas
pokemon.Pokedex: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

pokemon.Name: Giratina
pokemon.Pokedex: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

pokemon.Name: Cresselia
pokemon.Pokedex: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

pokemon.Name: Phione
pokemon.Pokedex: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.

pokemon.Name: Manaphy
pokemon.Pokedex: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

pokemon.Name: Darkrai
pokemon.Pokedex: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

pokemon.Name: Shaymin
pokemon.Pokedex: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

pokemon.Name: Arceus
pokemon.Pokedex: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

pokemon.Name: Victini
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

pokemon.Name: Snivy
pokemon.Pokedex: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

pokemon.Name: Servine
pokemon.Pokedex: They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

pokemon.Name: Serperior
pokemon.Pokedex: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents, but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

pokemon.Name: Tepig
pokemon.Pokedex: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

pokemon.Name: Pignite
pokemon.Pokedex: Whatever it eats becomes fuel for the flame in its stomach. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.

pokemon.Name: Emboar
pokemon.Pokedex: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

pokemon.Name: Oshawott
pokemon.Pokedex: The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.

pokemon.Name: Dewott
pokemon.Pokedex: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

pokemon.Name: Samurott
pokemon.Pokedex: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

pokemon.Name: Patrat
pokemon.Pokedex: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.

pokemon.Name: Watchog
pokemon.Pokedex: They make the patterns on their bodies shine in order to threaten predators. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.

pokemon.Name: Lillipup
pokemon.Pokedex: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.

pokemon.Name: Herdier
pokemon.Pokedex: It loyally follows its Trainer's orders. For ages, they have helped Trainers raise Pokémon.

pokemon.Name: Stoutland
pokemon.Pokedex: This extremely wise Pokémon excels at rescuing people stranded at sea or in the mountains.

pokemon.Name: Purrloin
pokemon.Pokedex: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

pokemon.Name: Liepard
pokemon.Pokedex: Stealthily, it sneaks up on its target, striking from behind before its victim has a chance to react.

pokemon.Name: Pansage
pokemon.Pokedex: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

pokemon.Name: Simisage
pokemon.Pokedex: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

pokemon.Name: Pansear
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600º F.

pokemon.Name: Simisear
pokemon.Pokedex: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

pokemon.Name: Panpour
pokemon.Pokedex: It does not thrive in dry environments. It keeps itself damp by shooting water stored in its head tuft from its tail.

pokemon.Name: Simipour
pokemon.Pokedex: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

pokemon.Name: Munna
pokemon.Pokedex: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dreams, it expels pink-colored mist.

pokemon.Name: Musharna
pokemon.Pokedex: With the mist from its forehead, it can create shapes of things from dreams it has eaten.

pokemon.Name: Pidove
pokemon.Pokedex: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

pokemon.Name: Tranquill
pokemon.Pokedex: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.

pokemon.Name: Unfezant
pokemon.Pokedex: Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves feel close to anyone other than their Trainers.

pokemon.Name: Blitzle
pokemon.Pokedex: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

pokemon.Name: Zebstrika
pokemon.Pokedex: This ill-tempered Pokémon is dangerous because when it's angry, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

pokemon.Name: Roggenrola
pokemon.Pokedex: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.

pokemon.Name: Boldore
pokemon.Pokedex: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

pokemon.Name: Gigalith
pokemon.Pokedex: The solar energy absorbed by its body's orange crystals is magnified internally and fired from its mouth.

pokemon.Name: Woobat
pokemon.Pokedex: Suction from its nostrils enables it to stick to cave walls during sleep. It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.

pokemon.Name: Swoobat
pokemon.Pokedex: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

pokemon.Name: Drilbur
pokemon.Pokedex: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

pokemon.Name: Excadrill
pokemon.Pokedex: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.

pokemon.Name: Audino
pokemon.Pokedex: Its auditory sense is astounding. It has a radar-like ability to understand its surrounding through slight sounds.

pokemon.Name: Timburr
pokemon.Pokedex: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.

pokemon.Name: Gurdurr
pokemon.Pokedex: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. They show off their big muscles to their friends.

pokemon.Name: Conkeldurr
pokemon.Pokedex: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. They know moves that enable them to swing the pillars freely in battle.

pokemon.Name: Tympole
pokemon.Pokedex: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

pokemon.Name: Palpitoad
pokemon.Pokedex: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.

pokemon.Name: Seismitoad
pokemon.Pokedex: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

pokemon.Name: Throh
pokemon.Pokedex: When they encounter foes bigger than themselves, they try to throw them. They always travel in packs of five.

pokemon.Name: Sawk
pokemon.Pokedex: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

pokemon.Name: Sewaddle
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

pokemon.Name: Swadloon
pokemon.Pokedex: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

pokemon.Name: Leavanny
pokemon.Pokedex: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

pokemon.Name: Venipede
pokemon.Pokedex: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggresive.

pokemon.Name: Whirlipede
pokemon.Pokedex: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.

pokemon.Name: Scolipede
pokemon.Pokedex: Highly aggressive, it uses the claws near its neck to dig into its opponents and poison them.

pokemon.Name: Cottonee
pokemon.Pokedex: They go wherever the wind takes them. On rainy days, their bodies are heavier, so they take shelter beneath big trees.

pokemon.Name: Whimsicott
pokemon.Pokedex: Riding whirlwinds, they appear. These Pokémon sneak through gaps into houses and cause all sorts of mischief.

pokemon.Name: Petilil
pokemon.Pokedex: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

pokemon.Name: Lilligant
pokemon.Pokedex: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.

pokemon.Name: Basculin
pokemon.Pokedex: Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.

pokemon.Name: Sandile
pokemon.Pokedex: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

pokemon.Name: Krokorok
pokemon.Pokedex: The special membrane covering its eyes can sense the heat of objects, so it can see its surroundings, even in darkness.

pokemon.Name: Krookodile
pokemon.Pokedex: It can expand the focus of its eyes, enabling it to see objects in the far distance as if it were using binoculars.

pokemon.Name: Darumaka
pokemon.Pokedex: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

pokemon.Name: Darmanitan
pokemon.Pokedex: When weakened in battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.

pokemon.Name: Maractus
pokemon.Pokedex: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

pokemon.Name: Dwebble
pokemon.Pokedex: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

pokemon.Name: Crustle
pokemon.Pokedex: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.

pokemon.Name: Scraggy
pokemon.Pokedex: It immediately headbutts anyone that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is massively thick.

pokemon.Name: Scrafty
pokemon.Pokedex: It can smash concrete blocks with its kicking attacks. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader.

pokemon.Name: Sigilyph
pokemon.Pokedex: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.

pokemon.Name: Yamask
pokemon.Pokedex: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each retains memories of its former life.

pokemon.Name: Cofagrigus
pokemon.Pokedex: They pretend to be elaborate coffins to teach lessons to grave robbers. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.

pokemon.Name: Tirtouga
pokemon.Pokedex: About 100 million years ago, these Pokémon swam in oceans. It is thought they also went on land to attack prey.

pokemon.Name: Carracosta
pokemon.Pokedex: Incredible jaw strength enables them to chew up steel beams and rocks along with their prey.

pokemon.Name: Archen
pokemon.Pokedex: Revived from a fossil, this Pokémon is thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon.

pokemon.Name: Archeops
pokemon.Pokedex: It runs better than it flies. It catches prey by running at speeds comparable to those of an automobile.

pokemon.Name: Trubbish
pokemon.Pokedex: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that crated this Pokémon.

pokemon.Name: Garbodor
pokemon.Pokedex: They absorb garbage and make it part of their bodies. They shoot a poisonous liquid from their right-hand fingertips.

pokemon.Name: Zorua
pokemon.Pokedex: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

pokemon.Name: Zoroark
pokemon.Pokedex: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

pokemon.Name: Minccino
pokemon.Pokedex: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

pokemon.Name: Cinccino
pokemon.Pokedex: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.

pokemon.Name: Gothita
pokemon.Pokedex: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.

pokemon.Name: Gothorita
pokemon.Pokedex: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

pokemon.Name: Gothitelle
pokemon.Pokedex: They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They can see Trainers' life spans.

pokemon.Name: Solosis
pokemon.Pokedex: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they can survive in any environment.

pokemon.Name: Duosion
pokemon.Pokedex: When their brains, now divided in two, are thinking the same thoughts, these Pokémon exhibit their maximum power.

pokemon.Name: Reuniclus
pokemon.Pokedex: These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.

pokemon.Name: Ducklett
pokemon.Pokedex: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

pokemon.Name: Swanna
pokemon.Pokedex: It administers sharp, powerful pecks with its bill. It whips its long neck to deliver forceful repeated strikes.

pokemon.Name: Vanillite
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.

pokemon.Name: Vanillish
pokemon.Pokedex: It conceals itself from enemy eyes by creating many small ice particles and hiding among them.

pokemon.Name: Vanilluxe
pokemon.Pokedex: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.

pokemon.Name: Deerling
pokemon.Pokedex: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

pokemon.Name: Sawsbuck
pokemon.Pokedex: The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.

pokemon.Name: Emolga
pokemon.Pokedex: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.

pokemon.Name: Karrablast
pokemon.Pokedex: When they feel threatened, they spit an acidic liquid to drive attackers away. This Pokémon targets Shelmet.

pokemon.Name: Escavalier
pokemon.Pokedex: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.

pokemon.Name: Foongus
pokemon.Pokedex: For some reason, this Pokémon resembles a Poké Ball. They release poison spores to repel those who try to catch them.

pokemon.Name: Amoonguss
pokemon.Pokedex: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

pokemon.Name: Frillish
pokemon.Pokedex: They paralyze prey with poison, then drag them down to their lairs, five miles below the surface.

pokemon.Name: Jellicent
pokemon.Pokedex: They propel themselves by expelling absorbed seawater from their bodies. Their favorite food is life energy.

pokemon.Name: Alomomola
pokemon.Pokedex: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

pokemon.Name: Joltik
pokemon.Pokedex: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

pokemon.Name: Galvantula
pokemon.Pokedex: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

pokemon.Name: Ferroseed
pokemon.Pokedex: They stick their spikes into cave walls and absorb the minerals they find in the rock.

pokemon.Name: Ferrothorn
pokemon.Pokedex: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

pokemon.Name: Klink
pokemon.Pokedex: Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.

pokemon.Name: Klang
pokemon.Pokedex: Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

pokemon.Name: Klinklang
pokemon.Pokedex: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.

pokemon.Name: Tynamo
pokemon.Pokedex: These Pokémon move in schools. They have an electricity-generating organ, so they discharge electricity if in danger.

pokemon.Name: Eelektrik
pokemon.Pokedex: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

pokemon.Name: Eelektross
pokemon.Pokedex: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

pokemon.Name: Elgyem
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon had never been seen until it appeared from far in the desert 50 years ago.

pokemon.Name: Beheeyem
pokemon.Pokedex: It uses psychic power to control an opponent's brain and tamper with its memories.

pokemon.Name: Litwick
pokemon.Pokedex: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

pokemon.Name: Lampent
pokemon.Pokedex: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.

pokemon.Name: Chandelure
pokemon.Pokedex: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

pokemon.Name: Axew
pokemon.Pokedex: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

pokemon.Name: Fraxure
pokemon.Pokedex: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.

pokemon.Name: Haxorus
pokemon.Pokedex: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.

pokemon.Name: Cubchoo
pokemon.Pokedex: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.

pokemon.Name: Beartic
pokemon.Pokedex: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.

pokemon.Name: Cryogonal
pokemon.Pokedex: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

pokemon.Name: Shelmet
pokemon.Pokedex: It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast. The reason is still unknown.

pokemon.Name: Accelgor
pokemon.Pokedex: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

pokemon.Name: Stunfisk
pokemon.Pokedex: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of energy.

pokemon.Name: Mienfoo
pokemon.Pokedex: They have mastered elegant combos. As they concentrate, their battle moves become swifter and more precise.

pokemon.Name: Mienshao
pokemon.Pokedex: They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents.

pokemon.Name: Druddigon
pokemon.Pokedex: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. Then skin on its face is harder than a rock.

pokemon.Name: Golett
pokemon.Pokedex: These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization.

pokemon.Name: Golurk
pokemon.Pokedex: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

pokemon.Name: Pawniard
pokemon.Pokedex: They fight at Bisharp's command. They cling to their prey and inflict damage by sinking their blades into it.

pokemon.Name: Bisharp
pokemon.Pokedex: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

pokemon.Name: Bouffalant
pokemon.Pokedex: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. They headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

pokemon.Name: Rufflet
pokemon.Pokedex: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.

pokemon.Name: Braviary
pokemon.Pokedex: The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.

pokemon.Name: Vullaby
pokemon.Pokedex: They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.

pokemon.Name: Mandibuzz
pokemon.Pokedex: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.

pokemon.Name: Heatmor
pokemon.Pokedex: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

pokemon.Name: Durant
pokemon.Pokedex: Durant dig nests in mountains. They build their complicated, interconnected tunnels in mazes.

pokemon.Name: Deino
pokemon.Pokedex: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

pokemon.Name: Zweilous
pokemon.Pokedex: Since their two heads do not get along and compete with each other for food, they always eat too much.

pokemon.Name: Hydreigon
pokemon.Pokedex: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

pokemon.Name: Larvesta
pokemon.Pokedex: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

pokemon.Name: Volcarona
pokemon.Pokedex: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

pokemon.Name: Cobalion
pokemon.Pokedex: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.

pokemon.Name: Terrakion
pokemon.Pokedex: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

pokemon.Name: Virizion
pokemon.Pokedex: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

pokemon.Name: Tornadus
pokemon.Pokedex: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

pokemon.Name: Thundurus
pokemon.Pokedex: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

pokemon.Name: Reshiram
pokemon.Pokedex: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

pokemon.Name: Zekrom
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

pokemon.Name: Landorus
pokemon.Pokedex: The energy that comes pouring from its tail increases the nutrition in the soil, making crops grow to great size.

pokemon.Name: Kyurem
pokemon.Pokedex: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

pokemon.Name: Keldeo
pokemon.Pokedex: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

pokemon.Name: Meloetta
pokemon.Pokedex: Many famous songs have been inspired by the melodies that Meloetta plays.

pokemon.Name: Genesect
pokemon.Pokedex: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

pokemon.Name: Chespin
pokemon.Pokedex: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

pokemon.Name: Quilladin
pokemon.Pokedex: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won't start fights.

pokemon.Name: Chesnaught
pokemon.Pokedex: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

pokemon.Name: Fennekin
pokemon.Pokedex: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

pokemon.Name: Braixen
pokemon.Pokedex: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

pokemon.Name: Delphox
pokemon.Pokedex: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.

pokemon.Name: Froakie
pokemon.Pokedex: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

pokemon.Name: Frogadier
pokemon.Pokedex: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

pokemon.Name: Greninja
pokemon.Pokedex: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

pokemon.Name: Bunnelby
pokemon.Pokedex: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly.

pokemon.Name: Diggersby
pokemon.Pokedex: As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble. When it's finished digging, it lounges lazily.

pokemon.Name: Fletchling
pokemon.Pokedex: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

pokemon.Name: Fletchinder
pokemon.Pokedex: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.

pokemon.Name: Talonflame
pokemon.Pokedex: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.

pokemon.Name: Scatterbug
pokemon.Pokedex: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.

pokemon.Name: Spewpa
pokemon.Pokedex: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.

pokemon.Name: Vivillon
pokemon.Pokedex: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.

pokemon.Name: Litleo
pokemon.Pokedex: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

pokemon.Name: Pyroar
pokemon.Pokedex: With fiery breath of more than 6,000 degrees Celsius, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride's cubs.

pokemon.Name: Flabébé
pokemon.Pokedex: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.

pokemon.Name: Floette
pokemon.Pokedex: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the power of flowers to battle.

pokemon.Name: Florges
pokemon.Pokedex: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

pokemon.Name: Skiddo
pokemon.Pokedex: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

pokemon.Name: Gogoat
pokemon.Pokedex: It can tell how its trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathetic sense lets them run as if one being.

pokemon.Name: Pancham
pokemon.Pokedex: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

pokemon.Name: Pangoro
pokemon.Pokedex: It charges ahead and bashes its opponents like a berserker, uncaring about any hits it might take. Its arms are mighty enough to snap a telephone pole.

pokemon.Name: Furfrou
pokemon.Pokedex: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

pokemon.Name: Espurr
pokemon.Pokedex: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

pokemon.Name: Meowstic
pokemon.Pokedex: Revealing the eyelike patterns on the insides of its ears will unleash its psychic powers. It normally keeps the patterns hidden, however.

pokemon.Name: Honedge
pokemon.Pokedex: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

pokemon.Name: Doublade
pokemon.Pokedex: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

pokemon.Name: Aegislash
pokemon.Pokedex: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a force field of spectral power to reduce the damage of any attack.

pokemon.Name: Spritzee
pokemon.Pokedex: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

pokemon.Name: Aromatisse
pokemon.Pokedex: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.

pokemon.Name: Swirlix
pokemon.Pokedex: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

pokemon.Name: Slurpuff
pokemon.Pokedex: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

pokemon.Name: Inkay
pokemon.Pokedex: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

pokemon.Name: Malamar
pokemon.Pokedex: It lures prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids.

pokemon.Name: Binacle
pokemon.Pokedex: They stretch and then contract, yanking their rocks along with them in bold hops. They eat seaweed that washes up on the shoreline.

pokemon.Name: Barbaracle
pokemon.Pokedex: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head's orders.

pokemon.Name: Skrelp
pokemon.Pokedex: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.

pokemon.Name: Dragalge
pokemon.Pokedex: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.

pokemon.Name: Clauncher
pokemon.Pokedex: Through controlled expulsions of internal gas, it can expel water like a pistol shot. At close distances, it can shatter rock.

pokemon.Name: Clawitzer
pokemon.Pokedex: By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of its claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots.

pokemon.Name: Helioptile
pokemon.Pokedex: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

pokemon.Name: Heliolisk
pokemon.Pokedex: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

pokemon.Name: Tyrunt
pokemon.Pokedex: Its immense jaws have enough destructive force that it can chew up an automobile. It lived 100 million years ago.

pokemon.Name: Tyrantrum
pokemon.Pokedex: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.

pokemon.Name: Amaura
pokemon.Pokedex: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.

pokemon.Name: Aurorus
pokemon.Pokedex: Using its diamond-shaped crystals, it can instantly create a wall of ice to block an opponent's attack.

pokemon.Name: Sylveon
pokemon.Pokedex: Its ribbonlike feelers give off an aura that weakens hostility in its prey, causing them to let down their guard. Then it attacks.

pokemon.Name: Hawlucha
pokemon.Pokedex: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

pokemon.Name: Dedenne
pokemon.Pokedex: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

pokemon.Name: Carbink
pokemon.Pokedex: Born from the high temperatures and pressures deep underground, it defends itself by firing beams from the jewel part of its body.

pokemon.Name: Goomy
pokemon.Pokedex: Its source of protection is its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane. Anyone who touches it needs some thorough hand-washing.

pokemon.Name: Sliggoo
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon's mucous can dissolve anything. Toothless, it sprays mucous on its prey. Once they're nicely dissolved, it slurps them up.

pokemon.Name: Goodra
pokemon.Pokedex: It gets picked on because it's meek. But then, whoever teased it gets to feel the full force of its horns and a good swatting from its thick tail.

pokemon.Name: Klefki
pokemon.Pokedex: It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent crime.

pokemon.Name: Phantump
pokemon.Pokedex: These Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died in the forest. Their cries sound like eerie screams.

pokemon.Name: Trevenant
pokemon.Pokedex: Through its roots, it exerts control over other trees. A deadly curse falls upon anyone cutting down trees in forests where Trevenant dwell.

pokemon.Name: Pumpkaboo
pokemon.Pokedex: When taking spirits to the afterlife, small Pumpkaboo prefer the spirits of children to those of adults.

pokemon.Name: Gourgeist
pokemon.Pokedex: Small Gourgeist pretend to be children to fool adults. Anyone who falls for the act gets carried away to the hereafter.

pokemon.Name: Bergmite
pokemon.Pokedex: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.

pokemon.Name: Avalugg
pokemon.Pokedex: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

pokemon.Name: Noibat
pokemon.Pokedex: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

pokemon.Name: Noivern
pokemon.Pokedex: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

pokemon.Name: Xerneas
pokemon.Pokedex: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

pokemon.Name: Yveltal
pokemon.Pokedex: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

pokemon.Name: Zygarde
pokemon.Pokedex: It's thought to be monitoring the ecosystem. There are rumors that even greater power lies hidden within it.

pokemon.Name: Diancie
pokemon.Pokedex: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

pokemon.Name: Hoopa
pokemon.Pokedex: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

pokemon.Name: Volcanion
pokemon.Pokedex: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

pokemon.Name: Rowlet
pokemon.Pokedex: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

pokemon.Name: Dartrix
pokemon.Pokedex: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

pokemon.Name: Decidueye
pokemon.Pokedex: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.

pokemon.Name: Litten
pokemon.Pokedex: Its coat regrows twice a year. When the time comes, Litten sets its own body on fire and burns away the old fur.

pokemon.Name: Torracat
pokemon.Pokedex: It can act spoiled if it grows close to its Trainer. A powerful Pokémon, its sharp claws can leave its Trainer's whole body covered in scratches.

pokemon.Name: Incineroar
pokemon.Pokedex: Although it's rough mannered and egotistical, it finds beating down unworthy opponents boring. It gets motivated for stronger opponents.

pokemon.Name: Popplio
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

pokemon.Name: Brionne
pokemon.Pokedex: It gets excited when it sees a dance it doesn't know. This hard worker practices diligently until it can learn that dance.

pokemon.Name: Primarina
pokemon.Pokedex: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.

pokemon.Name: Pikipek
pokemon.Pokedex: It pecks at trees with its hard beak. You can get some idea of its mood or condition from the rhythm of its pecking.

pokemon.Name: Trumbeak
pokemon.Pokedex: It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.

pokemon.Name: Toucannon
pokemon.Pokedex: They smack beaks with others of their kind to communicate. The strength and number of hits tell each other how they feel.

pokemon.Name: Yungoos
pokemon.Pokedex: Its stomach takes up most of its long torso. It's a big eater, so the amount Trainers have to spend on its food is no laughing matter.

pokemon.Name: Gumshoos
pokemon.Pokedex: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location... but it's always snoozing by nightfall.

pokemon.Name: Grubbin
pokemon.Pokedex: It spits a sticky thread to stop opponents in their tracks, and then it grabs them in its sharp, sturdy mandibles to take them down.

pokemon.Name: Charjabug
pokemon.Pokedex: It buries itself in fallen leaves and barely moves, munching away on humus. If you accidentally step on one, you'll get a shock!

pokemon.Name: Vikavolt
pokemon.Pokedex: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.

pokemon.Name: Crabrawler
pokemon.Pokedex: It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly. What little meat they contain is rich and delicious.

pokemon.Name: Crabominable
pokemon.Pokedex: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.

pokemon.Name: Oricorio
pokemon.Pokedex: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.

pokemon.Name: Cutiefly
pokemon.Pokedex: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

pokemon.Name: Ribombee
pokemon.Pokedex: Rain makes pollen damp, so Ribombee hates rain. When it sees ominous clouds, it finds a hollow in a tree, where it waits stock-still.

pokemon.Name: Rockruff
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.

pokemon.Name: Lycanroc
pokemon.Pokedex: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.

pokemon.Name: Wishiwashi
pokemon.Pokedex: It's awfully weak and notably tasty, so everyone is always out to get it. As it happens, anyone trying to bully it receives a painful lesson.

pokemon.Name: Mareanie
pokemon.Pokedex: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

pokemon.Name: Toxapex
pokemon.Pokedex: Those attacked by Toxapex's poison will suffer intense pain for three days and three nights. Post-recovery, there will be some aftereffects.

pokemon.Name: Mudbray
pokemon.Pokedex: It loves playing in the mud. If it isn't showered with mud on a daily basis, it gets stressed out and stops listening to its Trainer.

pokemon.Name: Mudsdale
pokemon.Pokedex: It remains calm and unmoving no matter the situation. It mixes dirt with the saliva in its mouth to make a special kind of mud.

pokemon.Name: Dewpider
pokemon.Pokedex: When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other. Then the one with the smaller bubble gets out of the other's way.

pokemon.Name: Araquanid
pokemon.Pokedex: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

pokemon.Name: Fomantis
pokemon.Pokedex: When the sun rises, Fomantis spreads its four leaves and bathes in the sunlight. The tip of its head has a pleasant aroma.

pokemon.Name: Lurantis
pokemon.Pokedex: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis's vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.

pokemon.Name: Morelull
pokemon.Pokedex: It scatters its shining spores around itself. Even though they're dangerous, nighttime tours of forests where Morelull live are popular.

pokemon.Name: Shiinotic
pokemon.Pokedex: It puts its prey to sleep and siphons off their vitality through the tip of its arms. If one of its kind is weakened, it helps by sending it vitality.

pokemon.Name: Salandit
pokemon.Pokedex: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

pokemon.Name: Salazzle
pokemon.Pokedex: Filled with pheromones, its poisonous gas can be diluted to use in the production of luscious perfumes.

pokemon.Name: Stufful
pokemon.Pokedex: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

pokemon.Name: Bewear
pokemon.Pokedex: It waves its hands wildly in intimidation and warning. Life is over for anyone who doesn't run away as fast as possible.

pokemon.Name: Bounsweet
pokemon.Pokedex: Because of its sweet, delicious aroma, bird Pokémon are always after it, but it's not intelligent enough to care.

pokemon.Name: Steenee
pokemon.Pokedex: It's protected by its hard sepals, so it plays with bird Pokémon without worry. They peck it relentlessly, but it doesn't care.

pokemon.Name: Tsareena
pokemon.Pokedex: A Pokémon with an aggressive personality and a mastery of kicking, it cackles every time it kicks an opponent.

pokemon.Name: Comfey
pokemon.Pokedex: Baths prepared with the flowers from its vine have a relaxing effect, so this Pokémon is a hit with many people.

pokemon.Name: Oranguru
pokemon.Pokedex: It normally spends its time meditating in the treetops. It throws Poké Balls and gives other Pokémon orders as it pleases.

pokemon.Name: Passimian
pokemon.Pokedex: Berries are its weapons as well as the staple of its diet. The one that can throw a berry the farthest is the boss of the troop.

pokemon.Name: Wimpod
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

pokemon.Name: Golisopod
pokemon.Pokedex: It battles skillfully with its six arms, but spends most of its time peacefully meditating in caves deep beneath the sea.

pokemon.Name: Sandygast
pokemon.Pokedex: It likes the shovel on its head, so Sandygast will get serious and fight any children who come to take it back.

pokemon.Name: Palossand
pokemon.Pokedex: Buried beneath the castle are masses of dried-up bones from those whose vitality it has drained.

pokemon.Name: Pyukumuku
pokemon.Pokedex: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.

pokemon.Name: Type: Null
pokemon.Pokedex: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.

pokemon.Name: Silvally
pokemon.Pokedex: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokémon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.

pokemon.Name: Minior
pokemon.Pokedex: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.

pokemon.Name: Komala
pokemon.Pokedex: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.

pokemon.Name: Turtonator
pokemon.Pokedex: It lives in volcanoes and eats sulfur and other minerals. Materials from the food it eats form the basis of its explosive shell.

pokemon.Name: Togedemaru
pokemon.Pokedex: The long hairs on its back act as lightning rods. The bolts of lightning it attracts are stored as energy in its electric sac.

pokemon.Name: Mimikyu
pokemon.Pokedex: A lonely Pokémon, it conceals its terrifying appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer to people and other Pokémon.

pokemon.Name: Bruxish
pokemon.Pokedex: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.

pokemon.Name: Drampa
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon is friendly to people and loves children most of all. It comes from deep in the mountains to play with children it likes in town.

pokemon.Name: Dhelmise
pokemon.Pokedex: The soul of seaweed adrift in the waves became reborn as this Pokémon. It maintains itself with new infusions of seabed detritus and seaweed.

pokemon.Name: Jangmo-o
pokemon.Pokedex: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

pokemon.Name: Hakamo-o
pokemon.Pokedex: It sheds and regrows its scales on a continuous basis. The scales become harder and sharper each time they're regrown.

pokemon.Name: Kommo-o
pokemon.Pokedex: Its rigid scales function as offense and defense. In the past, its scales were processed and used to make weapons and other commodities.

pokemon.Name: Tapu Koko
pokemon.Pokedex: Although it's called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

pokemon.Name: Tapu Lele
pokemon.Pokedex: As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health on the spot.

pokemon.Name: Tapu Bulu
pokemon.Pokedex: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.

pokemon.Name: Tapu Fini
pokemon.Pokedex: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.

pokemon.Name: Cosmog
pokemon.Pokedex: Whether or not it's a Pokémon from this world is a mystery. When it's in a jam, it warps away to a safe place to hide.

pokemon.Name: Cosmoem
pokemon.Pokedex: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.

pokemon.Name: Solgaleo
pokemon.Pokedex: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

pokemon.Name: Lunala
pokemon.Pokedex: Said to live in another world, this Pokémon devours light, drawing the moonless dark veil of night over the brightness of day.

pokemon.Name: Nihilego
pokemon.Pokedex: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.

pokemon.Name: Buzzwole
pokemon.Pokedex: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.

pokemon.Name: Pheromosa
pokemon.Pokedex: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

pokemon.Name: Xurkitree
pokemon.Pokedex: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.

pokemon.Name: Celesteela
pokemon.Pokedex: One kind of Ultra Beast. Witnesses have seen it burn down a forest by expelling gas from its two arms.

pokemon.Name: Kartana
pokemon.Pokedex: One of the Ultra Beast life-forms, it was observed cutting down a gigantic steel tower with one stroke of its blade.

pokemon.Name: Guzzlord
pokemon.Pokedex: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it appears to be eating constantly, but for some reason its droppings have never been found.

pokemon.Name: Necrozma
pokemon.Pokedex: Light is apparently the source of its energy. It has an extraordinarily vicious disposition and is constantly firing off laser beams.

pokemon.Name: Magearna
pokemon.Pokedex: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.

pokemon.Name: Marshadow
pokemon.Pokedex: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

pokemon.Name: Poipole
pokemon.Pokedex: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.

pokemon.Name: Naganadel
pokemon.Pokedex: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.

pokemon.Name: Stakataka
pokemon.Pokedex: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute's true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.

pokemon.Name: Blacephalon
pokemon.Pokedex: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

pokemon.Name: Zeraora
pokemon.Pokedex: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

pokemon.Name: Meltan
pokemon.Pokedex: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

pokemon.Name: Melmetal
pokemon.Pokedex: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

pokemon.Name: Grookey
pokemon.Pokedex: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

pokemon.Name: Thwackey
pokemon.Pokedex: When it's drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won't even notice that it's already knocked out its opponent.

pokemon.Name: Rillaboom
pokemon.Pokedex: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

pokemon.Name: Scorbunny
pokemon.Pokedex: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

pokemon.Name: Raboot
pokemon.Pokedex: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

pokemon.Name: Cinderace
pokemon.Pokedex: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

pokemon.Name: Sobble
pokemon.Pokedex: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

pokemon.Name: Drizzile
pokemon.Pokedex: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

pokemon.Name: Inteleon
pokemon.Pokedex: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

pokemon.Name: Skwovet
pokemon.Pokedex: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It'll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.

pokemon.Name: Greedent
pokemon.Pokedex: It stashes berries in its tail - so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

pokemon.Name: Rookidee
pokemon.Pokedex: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

pokemon.Name: Corvisquire
pokemon.Pokedex: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

pokemon.Name: Corviknight
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

pokemon.Name: Blipbug
pokemon.Pokedex: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

pokemon.Name: Dottler
pokemon.Pokedex: It barely moves, but it's still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.

pokemon.Name: Orbeetle
pokemon.Pokedex: It's famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

pokemon.Name: Nickit
pokemon.Pokedex: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

pokemon.Name: Thievul
pokemon.Pokedex: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

pokemon.Name: Gossifleur
pokemon.Pokedex: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.

pokemon.Name: Eldegoss
pokemon.Pokedex: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.

pokemon.Name: Wooloo
pokemon.Pokedex: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

pokemon.Name: Dubwool
pokemon.Pokedex: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

pokemon.Name: Chewtle
pokemon.Pokedex: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

pokemon.Name: Drednaw
pokemon.Pokedex: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

pokemon.Name: Yamper
pokemon.Pokedex: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

pokemon.Name: Boltund
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

pokemon.Name: Rolycoly
pokemon.Pokedex: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

pokemon.Name: Carkol
pokemon.Pokedex: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,000 degrees Celsius.

pokemon.Name: Coalossal
pokemon.Pokedex: While it's engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

pokemon.Name: Applin
pokemon.Pokedex: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

pokemon.Name: Flapple
pokemon.Pokedex: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

pokemon.Name: Appletun
pokemon.Pokedex: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

pokemon.Name: Silicobra
pokemon.Pokedex: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

pokemon.Name: Sandaconda
pokemon.Pokedex: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

pokemon.Name: Cramorant
pokemon.Pokedex: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

pokemon.Name: Arrokuda
pokemon.Pokedex: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

pokemon.Name: Barraskewda
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

pokemon.Name: Toxel
pokemon.Pokedex: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

pokemon.Name: Toxtricity
pokemon.Pokedex: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

pokemon.Name: Sizzlipede
pokemon.Pokedex: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

pokemon.Name: Centiskorch
pokemon.Pokedex: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

pokemon.Name: Clobbopus
pokemon.Pokedex: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

pokemon.Name: Grapploct
pokemon.Pokedex: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

pokemon.Name: Sinistea
pokemon.Pokedex: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.

pokemon.Name: Polteageist
pokemon.Pokedex: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

pokemon.Name: Hatenna
pokemon.Pokedex: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

pokemon.Name: Hattrem
pokemon.Pokedex: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.

pokemon.Name: Hatterene
pokemon.Pokedex: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

pokemon.Name: Impidimp
pokemon.Pokedex: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

pokemon.Name: Morgrem
pokemon.Pokedex: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.

pokemon.Name: Grimmsnarl
pokemon.Pokedex: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.

pokemon.Name: Obstagoon
pokemon.Pokedex: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

pokemon.Name: Perrserker
pokemon.Pokedex: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

pokemon.Name: Cursola
pokemon.Pokedex: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

pokemon.Name: Sirfetch'd
pokemon.Pokedex: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.

pokemon.Name: Mr. Rime
pokemon.Pokedex: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

pokemon.Name: Runerigus
pokemon.Pokedex: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

pokemon.Name: Milcery
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

pokemon.Name: Alcremie
pokemon.Pokedex: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

pokemon.Name: Falinks
pokemon.Pokedex: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

pokemon.Name: Pincurchin
pokemon.Pokedex: It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for at least three hours.

pokemon.Name: Snom
pokemon.Pokedex: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

pokemon.Name: Frosmoth
pokemon.Pokedex: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

pokemon.Name: Stonjourner
pokemon.Pokedex: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

pokemon.Name: Eiscue
pokemon.Pokedex: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

pokemon.Name: Indeedee
pokemon.Pokedex: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

pokemon.Name: Morpeko
pokemon.Pokedex: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

pokemon.Name: Cufant
pokemon.Pokedex: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

pokemon.Name: Copperajah
pokemon.Pokedex: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

pokemon.Name: Dracozolt
pokemon.Pokedex: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

pokemon.Name: Arctozolt
pokemon.Pokedex: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

pokemon.Name: Dracovish
pokemon.Pokedex: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

pokemon.Name: Arctovish
pokemon.Pokedex: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

pokemon.Name: Duraludon
pokemon.Pokedex: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

pokemon.Name: Dreepy
pokemon.Pokedex: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

pokemon.Name: Drakloak
pokemon.Pokedex: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

pokemon.Name: Dragapult
pokemon.Pokedex: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

pokemon.Name: Zacian
pokemon.Pokedex: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.

pokemon.Name: Zamazenta
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.

pokemon.Name: Eternatus
pokemon.Pokedex: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

pokemon.Name: Kubfu
pokemon.Pokedex: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.

pokemon.Name: Urshifu
pokemon.Pokedex: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

pokemon.Name: Zarude
pokemon.Pokedex: Once the vines on Zarude's body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

pokemon.Name: Regieleki
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It's said that removing the rings on Regieleki's body will unleash the Pokémon's latent power.

pokemon.Name: Regidrago
pokemon.Pokedex: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.

pokemon.Name: Glastrier
pokemon.Pokedex: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.

pokemon.Name: Spectrier
pokemon.Pokedex: As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves silence and solitude.

pokemon.Name: Calyrex
pokemon.Pokedex: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

pokemon.Name: Wyrdeer
pokemon.Pokedex: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing

pokemon.Name: Kleavor
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon is a rough, crude, and violent sort. It swings around its large, heavy stone axes to finish off its prey.

pokemon.Name: Ursaluna
pokemon.Pokedex: The swampy terrain that Ursaluna lives in gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

pokemon.Name: Basculegion
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon is cloaked in the souls of its comrades who perished during a punishing journey to the river of their birth.

pokemon.Name: Sneasler
pokemon.Pokedex: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

pokemon.Name: Overqwil
pokemon.Pokedex: Overqwil's poisonous spikes will reflexively react even while Overqwil sleeps, stabbing any moving thing that approaches.

pokemon.Name: Enamorus
pokemon.Pokedex: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

pokemon.Name: Sprigatito
pokemon.Pokedex: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

pokemon.Name: Floragato
pokemon.Pokedex: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

pokemon.Name: Meowscarada
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining in its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

pokemon.Name: Fuecoco
pokemon.Pokedex: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

pokemon.Name: Crocalor
pokemon.Pokedex: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.

pokemon.Name: Skeledirge
pokemon.Pokedex: The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge's head gained a soul.

pokemon.Name: Quaxly
pokemon.Pokedex: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

pokemon.Name: Quaxwell
pokemon.Pokedex: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

pokemon.Name: Quaquaval
pokemon.Pokedex: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

pokemon.Name: Lechonk
pokemon.Pokedex: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

pokemon.Name: Oinkologne
pokemon.Pokedex: It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.

pokemon.Name: Tarountula
pokemon.Pokedex: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon's natural enemy.

pokemon.Name: Spidops
pokemon.Pokedex: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

pokemon.Name: Nymble
pokemon.Pokedex: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

pokemon.Name: Lokix
pokemon.Pokedex: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

pokemon.Name: Pawmi
pokemon.Pokedex: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

pokemon.Name: Pawmo
pokemon.Pokedex: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

pokemon.Name: Pawmot
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

pokemon.Name: Tandemaus
pokemon.Pokedex: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

pokemon.Name: Maushold
pokemon.Pokedex: They build huge nests with many rooms that are used for different purposes, such as eating and sleeping.

pokemon.Name: Fidough
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

pokemon.Name: Dachsbun
pokemon.Pokedex: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

pokemon.Name: Smoliv
pokemon.Pokedex: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

pokemon.Name: Dolliv
pokemon.Pokedex: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

pokemon.Name: Arboliva
pokemon.Pokedex: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

pokemon.Name: Squawkabilly
pokemon.Pokedex: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.

pokemon.Name: Nacli
pokemon.Pokedex: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli's body.

pokemon.Name: Naclstack
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey's body.

pokemon.Name: Garganacl
pokemon.Pokedex: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

pokemon.Name: Charcadet
pokemon.Pokedex: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

pokemon.Name: Armarouge
pokemon.Pokedex: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

pokemon.Name: Ceruledge
pokemon.Pokedex: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon's evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.

pokemon.Name: Tadbulb
pokemon.Pokedex: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.

pokemon.Name: Bellibolt
pokemon.Pokedex: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

pokemon.Name: Wattrel
pokemon.Pokedex: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

pokemon.Name: Kilowattrel
pokemon.Pokedex: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

pokemon.Name: Maschiff
pokemon.Pokedex: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

pokemon.Name: Mabosstiff
