pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon can store energy in its large dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all at once to blow away enemies.

pokemon.Name: Shroodle
pokemon.Pokedex: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

pokemon.Name: Grafaiai
pokemon.Pokedex: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

pokemon.Name: Bramblin
pokemon.Pokedex: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

pokemon.Name: Brambleghast
pokemon.Pokedex: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

pokemon.Name: Toedscool
pokemon.Pokedex: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.

pokemon.Name: Toedscruel
pokemon.Pokedex: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.

pokemon.Name: Klawf
pokemon.Pokedex: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

pokemon.Name: Capsakid
pokemon.Pokedex: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

pokemon.Name: Scovillain
pokemon.Pokedex: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

pokemon.Name: Rellor
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

pokemon.Name: Rabsca
pokemon.Pokedex: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

pokemon.Name: Flittle
pokemon.Pokedex: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

pokemon.Name: Espathra
pokemon.Pokedex: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

pokemon.Name: Tinkatink
pokemon.Pokedex: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

pokemon.Name: Tinkatuff
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

pokemon.Name: Tinkaton
pokemon.Pokedex: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

pokemon.Name: Wiglett
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

pokemon.Name: Wugtrio
pokemon.Pokedex: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

pokemon.Name: Bombirdier
pokemon.Pokedex: It gathers things up in an apron made from shed feathers added to the Pokémon's chest feathers, then drops those things from high places for fun.

pokemon.Name: Finizen
pokemon.Pokedex: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

pokemon.Name: Palafin
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.

pokemon.Name: Varoom
pokemon.Pokedex: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

pokemon.Name: Revavroom
pokemon.Pokedex: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

pokemon.Name: Cyclizar
pokemon.Pokedex: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

pokemon.Name: Orthworm
pokemon.Pokedex: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

pokemon.Name: Glimmet
pokemon.Pokedex: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

pokemon.Name: Glimmora
pokemon.Pokedex: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.

pokemon.Name: Greavard
pokemon.Pokedex: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

pokemon.Name: Houndstone
pokemon.Pokedex: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

pokemon.Name: Flamigo
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

pokemon.Name: Cetoddle
pokemon.Pokedex: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.

pokemon.Name: Cetitan
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with powerful muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.

pokemon.Name: Veluza
pokemon.Pokedex: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.

pokemon.Name: Dondozo
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

pokemon.Name: Tatsugiri
pokemon.Pokedex: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

pokemon.Name: Annihilape
pokemon.Pokedex: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.

pokemon.Name: Clodsire
pokemon.Pokedex: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It's a risky move that puts everything on the line.

pokemon.Name: Farigiraf
pokemon.Pokedex: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig's.

pokemon.Name: Dudunsparce
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

pokemon.Name: Kingambit
pokemon.Pokedex: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

pokemon.Name: Great Tusk
pokemon.Pokedex: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.

pokemon.Name: Scream Tail
pokemon.Pokedex: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.

pokemon.Name: Brute Bonnet
pokemon.Pokedex: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.

pokemon.Name: Flutter Mane
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.

pokemon.Name: Slither Wing
pokemon.Pokedex: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.

pokemon.Name: Sandy Shocks
pokemon.Pokedex: No records exist of this Pokémon being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon's traits match up with a creature shown in an expedition journal.

pokemon.Name: Iron Treads
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon closely resembles a scientific weapon that a paranormal magazine claimed was sent to this planet by aliens.

pokemon.Name: Iron Bundle
pokemon.Pokedex: Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a paranormal magazine article. The robot was said to have been created by an ancient civilization.

pokemon.Name: Iron Hands
pokemon.Pokedex: It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively by a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said to be the modified form of a certain athlete.

pokemon.Name: Iron Jugulis
pokemon.Pokedex: It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a paranormal magazine, described as the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.

pokemon.Name: Iron Moth
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon resembles an unknown object described in a paranormal magazine as a UFO sent to observe humanity.

pokemon.Name: Iron Thorns
pokemon.Pokedex: It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one billion years into the future.

pokemon.Name: Frigibax
pokemon.Pokedex: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

pokemon.Name: Arctibax
pokemon.Pokedex: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

pokemon.Name: Baxcalibur
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

pokemon.Name: Gimmighoul
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

pokemon.Name: Gholdengo
pokemon.Pokedex: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.

pokemon.Name: Wo-Chien
pokemon.Pokedex: The grudge of a person punished for writing the king's evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.

pokemon.Name: Chien-Pao
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.

pokemon.Name: Ting-Lu
pokemon.Pokedex: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.

pokemon.Name: Chi-Yu
pokemon.Pokedex: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

pokemon.Name: Roaring Moon
pokemon.Pokedex: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.

pokemon.Name: Iron Valiant
pokemon.Pokedex: It has some similarities to a mad scientist's invention covered in a paranormal magazine.

pokemon.Name: Koraidon
pokemon.Pokedex: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

pokemon.Name: Miraidon
pokemon.Pokedex: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.

pokemon.Name: Walking Wake
pokemon.Pokedex: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster mentioned in an old expedition journal.

pokemon.Name: Iron Leaves
pokemon.Pokedex: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

pokemon.Name: Dipplin
pokemon.Pokedex: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

pokemon.Name: Poltchageist
pokemon.Pokedex: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.

pokemon.Name: Sinistcha
pokemon.Pokedex: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.

pokemon.Name: Okidogi
pokemon.Pokedex: After all its muscles were stimulated by the toxic chain around its neck, Okidogi transformed and gained a powerful physique.

pokemon.Name: Munkidori
pokemon.Pokedex: The chain is made from toxins that enhance capabilities. It stimulated Munkidori's brain and caused the Pokémon's psychic powers to bloom.

pokemon.Name: Fezandipiti
pokemon.Pokedex: Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely voice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the chain wrapped around its body.

pokemon.Name: Ogerpon
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

pokemon.Name: Archaludon
pokemon.Pokedex: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.

pokemon.Name: Hydrapple
pokemon.Pokedex: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.

pokemon.Name: Gouging Fire
pokemon.Pokedex: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.

pokemon.Name: Raging Bolt
pokemon.Pokedex: It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature.

pokemon.Name: Iron Boulder
pokemon.Pokedex: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

pokemon.Name: Iron Crown
pokemon.Pokedex: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.

pokemon.Name: Terapagos
pokemon.Pokedex: Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon is the source of the Terastal phenomenon.

pokemon.Name: Pecharunt
pokemon.Pokedex: It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires and capabilities. Those who eat the mochi fall under Pecharunt's control, chained to its will.

pokemon.Name: Lumini
pokemon.Pokedex: A Weedle has an extremely acute sense of smell. It distinguishes its favorite kinds of leaves from those it dislikes by sniffing with its big red proboscis (nose).

pokemon.Name: Lampupa
pokemon.Pokedex: It remains virtually immobile while it clings to a tree. However, on the inside, it busily prepares for evolution. This is evident from how hot its shell becomes.

pokemon.Name: Glowyrm
pokemon.Pokedex: A Beedrill is extremely territorial. For safety reasons, no one should ever approach its nest. If angered, they will attack in a swarm.

pokemon.Name: Ribitar
pokemon.Pokedex: It was revived from a fossil found in a tar pit. Strangely, this Pokémon's face is inside its mouth! This evolutionary peculiarity has made it a true scientific curiosity as to how it survived like this.

pokemon.Name: Amphibrea
pokemon.Pokedex: Amphibrea basks in sunlight for most of the day, using its sticky skin like boiling-hot flypaper. In spite of its heavy body, its hind legs can vault its bulk into the air to crush foes.

pokemon.Name: Effipy
pokemon.Pokedex: Its feathers are made of sharp metal fibers that can cut through stone. This Pokémon is very hard to please and will chirp incessantly if it doesn't get its way.

pokemon.Name: Harpiron
pokemon.Pokedex: Harpiron are very fussy and stubborn Pokémon that aren't willing to back down from what they've learned. In ancient times, they were used to guard sacred places.

pokemon.Name: Cranoom
pokemon.Pokedex: They float freely wherever they go, startling everyone in its path. They say that when a Cranoom is seen in cities, wandering the streets, is a sign that someone soon die.

pokemon.Name: Graveton
pokemon.Pokedex: This spooky ghost is found in tunnels and abandoned houses, always lurking people and other pokemon. They are cold and not demonstrate any emotion.

pokemon.Name: Graveaper
pokemon.Pokedex: People avoid them, believing that they are the messengers of death. However, like all ghost Pokemon, they are wronged by their reputation. Even aggressive and frightening, the Graveapers have no intentions as morbid as lead someone to death.

pokemon.Name: Feenlust
pokemon.Pokedex: Its source of protection is its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane. Anyone who touches it needs some thorough hand-washing.

pokemon.Name: Mythidra
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon's mucous can dissolve anything. Toothless, it sprays mucous on its prey. Once they're nicely dissolved, it slurps them up.

pokemon.Name: Faedra
pokemon.Pokedex: It gets picked on because it's meek. But then, whoever teased it gets to feel the full force of its horns and a good swatting from its thick tail.

pokemon.Name: Buruchu
pokemon.Pokedex: They emit small electric jolts when scared or angry. Buruchu store low amounts of energy in their cheeks.

pokemon.Name: Purachu
pokemon.Pokedex: Purachu can store a lot of energy and unleash it all at once from the tip of its tail. This energy is, like lightning, plasmatic. Highly charged, Purachu emit bright blue light.

pokemon.Name: Denachu
pokemon.Pokedex: Denachu can create plasmatic energy they store in their body, and release it through their tail to attack. They are capable of flight, and soar through thunderclouds to absorb electricity.

pokemon.Name: Mantispar
pokemon.Pokedex: It could inflict serious wounds on opponents that are much larger than itself. A single blow from this creature could leave a crack on Kalamasag's shell.

pokemon.Name: Mantistrike
pokemon.Pokedex: By rapidly unfolding its claw, it could make a shock wave that leaves its enemies stunned. Aside from its colossal strength, its entire body is protected by an armor made from its aura.

pokemon.Name: Panizzy
pokemon.Pokedex: It is distinguished by a pattern of spots that is always different. Its unsteady, tottering walk has the effect of fouling its foe's aim.

pokemon.Name: Slucream
pokemon.Pokedex: A Weedle has an extremely acute sense of smell. It distinguishes its favorite kinds of leaves from those it dislikes by sniffing with its big red proboscis (nose).

pokemon.Name: Meadew
pokemon.Pokedex: They are able to orient themselves through the depths of the forests thanks to their small antennae.

pokemon.Name: Ninfae
pokemon.Pokedex: It is very vain; if you do anything that slightly alters its immaculate appearance, it gets angry, puffs out its cheeks, and attacks.

pokemon.Name: Faeuna
pokemon.Pokedex: They travel to small forests and help the plants grow. When the forest is very lush, they leave in search of another to repeat the process.

pokemon.Name: Tigglare
pokemon.Pokedex: Small Pokémon that is often seen roaming the countryside in search of berries. It illuminates the darkness with its ears and is easily distinguishable at night.

pokemon.Name: Rabatuta
pokemon.Pokedex: This cheerful Pokémon solidifies fragments of energy and moves them around like a baton before launching them in flames at its enemies.

pokemon.Name: Tignitus
pokemon.Pokedex: It attracts its prey with the melodies it plays at the tip of its tail. The musical notes it forms with psychic energy hypnotize anyone who hears them.

pokemon.Name: Gulliby
pokemon.Pokedex: Pokémon that live near the coast, mostly in fishing areas. Many Gulliby together warn sailors of an approaching storm.

pokemon.Name: Saigull
pokemon.Pokedex: Turn stones into fireballs by tapping them, then kick them forcefully towards the opponent to scorch them.

pokemon.Name: Seaghoul
pokemon.Pokedex: It breaks away from its group after evolving and sets off in search of items it considers valuable. It takes advantage of the storms it creates to attack.

pokemon.Name: Enchantow
pokemon.Pokedex: It can hunt in the dark because it has exceptional eyesight that allows it to see in very low light. It has lightweight wings that make almost no noise when flying.

pokemon.Name: Octank
pokemon.Pokedex: It grabs its enemy with its tentacles and immobilizes it before delivering the final blow. If the opponent is very strong, it spits ink to escape.

pokemon.Name: Widogre
pokemon.Pokedex: Widogre has hook-shaped legs that allow it to run across ceilings and vertical surfaces. It traps its opponent with a thin, strong spider web.

pokemon.Name: Corsolala
pokemon.Pokedex: Corsolala live in warm southern seas. If the sea becomes polluted, the beautiful coral stalks become discolored and crumble away in tatters.

pokemon.Name: Rowbug
pokemon.Pokedex: It traps a thin layer of air beneath its shell before diving. Its tiny legs beat like oars, letting it dart between reeds without disturbing the water.

pokemon.Name: Bugboat
pokemon.Pokedex: Its broad hind legs can propel it across a pond in a heartbeat. When carrying smaller Rowbug through rough currents, it shelters them beneath its air-filled shell.

pokemon.Name: Amplipom
pokemon.Pokedex: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

pokemon.Name: Highyena
pokemon.Pokedex: In the wild, Mightyena live in a pack. They never defy their leader's orders. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

pokemon.Name: Solflora
pokemon.Pokedex: Sunflora convert solar energy into nutrition. They are highly active in the warm daytime but suddenly stop moving as soon as the sun sets.

pokemon.Name: Venusaur
pokemon.Pokedex: In order to support its flower, which has grown larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs have become stronger.

pokemon.Name: Charizard
pokemon.Pokedex: The overwhelming power that fills its entire body causes it to turn black and create intense blue flames.

pokemon.Name: Charizard
pokemon.Pokedex: Its bond with its Trainer is the source of its power. It boasts speed and maneuverability greater than that of a jet fighter.

pokemon.Name: Blastoise
pokemon.Pokedex: The cannon on its back is as powerful as a tank gun. Its tough legs and back enable it to withstand the recoil from firing the cannon.

pokemon.Name: Beedrill
pokemon.Pokedex: Its legs have become poison stingers. It stabs its prey repeatedly with the stingers on its limbs, dealing the final blow with the stinger on its rear.

pokemon.Name: Pidgeot
pokemon.Pokedex: With its muscular strength now greatly increased, it can fly continuously for two weeks without resting.

pokemon.Name: Rattata
pokemon.Pokedex: With its incisors, it gnaws through doors and infiltrates people's homes. Then, with a twitch of its whiskers, it steals whatever food it finds.

pokemon.Name: Raticate
pokemon.Pokedex: It forms a group of Rattata, which it assumes command of. Each group has its own territory, and disputes over food happen often.

pokemon.Name: Raichu
pokemon.Pokedex: It uses psychokinesis to control electricity. It hops aboard its own tail, using psychic power to lift the tail and move about while riding it.

pokemon.Name: Sandshrew
pokemon.Pokedex: The skin on its back is as hard as steel. Predators go after its soft belly, so it clings to the ground desperately.

pokemon.Name: Sandslash
pokemon.Pokedex: It runs across snow-covered plains at high speeds. It developed thick, sharp claws to plow through the snow.

pokemon.Name: Vulpix
pokemon.Pokedex: In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.

pokemon.Name: Ninetales
pokemon.Pokedex: It lives on mountains perpetually covered in snow and is revered as a deity incarnate. It appears draped in a blizzard.

pokemon.Name: Diglett
pokemon.Pokedex: Its head sports an altered form of whiskers made of metal. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

pokemon.Name: Dugtrio
pokemon.Pokedex: Its shining gold hair provides it with protection. It's reputed that keeping any of its fallen hairs will bring bad luck.

pokemon.Name: Meowth
pokemon.Pokedex: It's impulsive, selfish, and fickle. It's very popular with some Trainers who like giving it the attention it needs.

pokemon.Name: Meowth
pokemon.Pokedex: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

pokemon.Name: Persian
pokemon.Pokedex: Its round face is a symbol of wealth. Persian that have bigger, plumper faces are considered more beautiful.

pokemon.Name: Alakazam
pokemon.Pokedex: Having traded away its muscles, Alakazam's true power has been unleashed. With its psychic powers, it can foresee all things.

pokemon.Name: Geodude
pokemon.Pokedex: Geodude compete against each other with headbutts. The iron sand on their heads will stick to whichever one has stronger magnetism.

pokemon.Name: Graveler
pokemon.Pokedex: They eat rocks and often get into a scrap over them. The shock of Graveler smashing together causes a flash of light and a booming noise.

pokemon.Name: Golem
pokemon.Pokedex: It fires rocks charged with electricity. Even if the rock isn't fired that accurately, just grazing an opponent will cause numbness and fainting.

pokemon.Name: Ponyta
pokemon.Pokedex: Its small horn hides a healing power. With a few rubs from this Pokémon's horn, any slight wound you have will be healed.

pokemon.Name: Rapidash
pokemon.Pokedex: Little can stand up to its psycho cut. Unleashed from this Pokémon's horn, the move will punch a hole right through a thick metal sheet.

pokemon.Name: Slowpoke
pokemon.Pokedex: Although this Pokémon is normally zoned out, its expression abruptly sharpens on occasion. The cause for this seems to lie in Slowpoke's diet.

pokemon.Name: Slowbro
pokemon.Pokedex: If this Pokémon squeezes the tongue of the Shellder biting it, the Shellder will launch a toxic liquid from the tip of its shell.

pokemon.Name: Slowbro
pokemon.Pokedex: Having been swallowed whole by Shellder, Slowbro now has an iron defense. It's pretty comfortable in there, too.

pokemon.Name: Farfetch'd
pokemon.Pokedex: The stalks of leeks are thicker and longer in the Galar region. Farfetch'd that adapted to these stalks took on a unique form.

pokemon.Name: Grimer
pokemon.Pokedex: A Grimer, which had been brought in to solve a problem with garbage, developed over time into this form.

pokemon.Name: Muk
pokemon.Pokedex: The garbage it eats causes continuous chemical changes in its body, which produce its exceedingly vivid coloration.

pokemon.Name: Gengar
pokemon.Pokedex: The energy of Mega Evolution awakened it. It sinks into another dimension, where it keeps a patient watch for its chance to attack.

pokemon.Name: Exeggutor
pokemon.Pokedex: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

pokemon.Name: Cubone
pokemon.Pokedex: It pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull it wears are from its tears.

pokemon.Name: Marowak
pokemon.Pokedex: Its custom is to mourn its lost companions. Mounds of dirt by the side of the road mark the graves of the Marowak.

pokemon.Name: Weezing
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.

pokemon.Name: Kangaskhan
pokemon.Pokedex: The explosive energy the child is bathed in causes temporary growth. The mother is beside herself with worry about it.

pokemon.Name: Mr. Mime
pokemon.Pokedex: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

pokemon.Name: Pinsir
pokemon.Pokedex: It zips around at blistering speeds, looking for an opening to skewer its opponent on its giant pincers.

pokemon.Name: Gyarados
pokemon.Pokedex: It zooms out of the water at Mach speeds. Even large ships caught in its path are split cleanly in two!

pokemon.Name: Aerodactyl
pokemon.Pokedex: When it Mega Evolves, it becomes more vicious than ever before. Some say that's because its excess of power is causing it pain.

pokemon.Name: Articuno
pokemon.Pokedex: Its feather-like blades are composed of psychic energy and can shear through thick iron sheets as if they were paper.

pokemon.Name: Zapdos
pokemon.Pokedex: When its feathers rub together, they produce a crackling sound like the zapping of electricity. That's why this Pokémon is called Zapdos.

pokemon.Name: Moltres
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon's sinister, flame-like aura will consume the spirit of any creature it hits. Victims become burned-out shadows of themselves.

pokemon.Name: Mewtwo
pokemon.Pokedex: Psychic power has augmented its muscles. It has a grip strength of one ton and can sprint a hundred meters in two seconds flat!

pokemon.Name: Mewtwo
pokemon.Pokedex: Despite its diminished size, its mental power has grown phenomenally. With a mere thought, it can smash a skyscraper to smithereens.

pokemon.Name: Pichu
pokemon.Pokedex: It is still inept at retaining electricity. When it is startled, it discharges power accidentally. It gets better at holding power as it grows older.

pokemon.Name: Ampharos
pokemon.Pokedex: Massive amounts of energy intensely stimulated Ampharos's cells, apparently awakening its long-sleeping dragon's blood.

pokemon.Name: Slowking
pokemon.Pokedex: While chanting strange spells, this Pokémon combines its internal toxins with what it's eaten, creating strange potions.

pokemon.Name: Unown
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon is shaped like ancient text characters. Although research is ongoing, it is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various Unown.

pokemon.Name: Steelix
pokemon.Pokedex: Steelix live even further underground than Onix. This Pokémon is known to dig toward the earth's core, reaching a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.

pokemon.Name: Scizor
pokemon.Pokedex: It's better at beating things than grasping them. When it battles for a long time, the weight of its pincers becomes too much to bear.

pokemon.Name: Heracross
pokemon.Pokedex: A tremendous influx of energy builds it up, but when Mega Evolution ends, Heracross is bothered by terrible soreness in its muscles.

pokemon.Name: Corsola
pokemon.Pokedex: Sudden climate change wiped out this ancient kind of Corsola. This Pokémon absorbs others' life-force through its branches.

pokemon.Name: Houndoom
pokemon.Pokedex: Its red claws and the tips of its tail are melting from high internal temperatures that are painful to Houndoom itself.

pokemon.Name: Tyranitar
pokemon.Pokedex: Due to the colossal power poured into it, this Pokémon's back split right open. Its destructive instincts are the only thing keeping it moving.

pokemon.Name: Sceptile
pokemon.Pokedex: In the jungle, its power is without equal. This Pokémon carefully grows trees and plants. It regulates its body temperature by basking in sunlight.

pokemon.Name: Blaziken
pokemon.Pokedex: It learns martial arts that use punches and kicks. Every several years, its old feathers burn off, and new, supple feathers grow back in their place.

pokemon.Name: Swampert
pokemon.Pokedex: If it senses the approach of a storm and a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as a jet ski.

pokemon.Name: Zigzagoon
pokemon.Pokedex: Its restlessness has it constantly running around. If it sees another Pokémon, it will purposely run into them in order to start a fight.

pokemon.Name: Linoone
pokemon.Pokedex: It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents. Once the opposition is enraged, this Pokémon hurls itself at the opponent, tackling them forcefully.

pokemon.Name: Gardevoir
pokemon.Pokedex: It apparently does not feel the pull of gravity because it supports itself with psychic power. It will give its life to protect its trainer.

pokemon.Name: Sableye
pokemon.Pokedex: Supporting a giant heavy jewel, it can't change direction very nimbly and is vulnerable to attack from behind.

pokemon.Name: Mawile
pokemon.Pokedex: Its two sets of jaws thrash about violently as if they each had a will of their own. One gnash from them can turn a boulder to dust.

pokemon.Name: Aggron
pokemon.Pokedex: Its iron horns grow longer a little at a time. They are used to determine the Aggron's age. The gouges in its armor are worn with pride as mementos from battles.

pokemon.Name: Medicham
pokemon.Pokedex: Through crushingly harsh yoga training, it gained the power to foretell its foe's actions. It battles with elegant, dance- like movement.

pokemon.Name: Manectric
pokemon.Pokedex: Too much electricity has built up in its body, irritating Manectric. Its explosive speed is equal to that of a lightning bolt.

pokemon.Name: Sharpedo
pokemon.Pokedex: The yellow patterns it bears are old scars. The energy from Mega Evolution runs through them, causing it sharp pain and suffering.

pokemon.Name: Camerupt
pokemon.Pokedex: A Pokémon that lives in the crater of a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes on its back erupt violently. Research is under way on the cause of eruption.

pokemon.Name: Altaria
pokemon.Pokedex: It hums in a beautiful soprano voice. It flies among white clouds in the blue sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs from its mouth.

pokemon.Name: Castform
pokemon.Pokedex: This is the form Castform takes on the brightest of days. Its skin is unexpectedly hot to the touch, so approach with care.

pokemon.Name: Castform
pokemon.Pokedex: This is the form Castform takes when soaked with rain. When its body is compressed, water will seep out as if from a sponge.

pokemon.Name: Castform
pokemon.Pokedex: This is the form Castform takes when covered in snow. Its body becomes an ice-like material, with a temperature near -5 degrees Celsius.

pokemon.Name: Banette
pokemon.Pokedex: Extraordinary energy amplifies its cursing power to such an extent that it can't help but curse its own Trainer.

pokemon.Name: Absol
pokemon.Pokedex: When this Pokémon whips the winglike fur on its back as though beating its wings, it sends an intimidating aura flying at its opponents.

pokemon.Name: Glalie
pokemon.Pokedex: It envelops prey in its mouth, freezing them instantly. But its jaw is dislocated, so it's unable to eat them.

pokemon.Name: Salamence
pokemon.Pokedex: It puts its forelegs inside its shell to streamline itself for flight. Salamence flies at high speeds over all kinds of topographical features.

pokemon.Name: Metagross
pokemon.Pokedex: Its intellect surpasses its previous level, resulting in battles so cruel, they'll make you want to cover your eyes.

pokemon.Name: Latias
pokemon.Pokedex: They make a small herd of only several members. They rarely make contact with people or other Pokémon. They disappear if they sense enemies.

pokemon.Name: Latios
pokemon.Pokedex: Even in hiding, it can detect the locations of others and sense their emotions since it has telepathy. Its intelligence allows it to understand human languages.

pokemon.Name: Kyogre
pokemon.Pokedex: Kyogre has appeared in mythology as the creator of the sea. After long years of feuding with Groudon, it took to sleep at the bottom of the sea.

pokemon.Name: Groudon
pokemon.Pokedex: Groudon has appeared in mythology as the creator of the land. It sleeps in magma underground and is said to make volcanoes erupt on awakening.

pokemon.Name: Rayquaza
pokemon.Pokedex: A Pokémon that flies endlessly in the ozone layer. It is said it would descend to the ground if Kyogre and Groudon were to fight.

pokemon.Name: Deoxys
pokemon.Pokedex: A Pokémon that mutated from an extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser beam. Its body is configured for superior agility and speed.

pokemon.Name: Shellos
pokemon.Pokedex: Its appearance changes depending on the environment. One theory suggests that living in cold seas causes Shellos to take on this form.

pokemon.Name: Gastrodon
pokemon.Pokedex: Its body is covered in a sticky slime. It's very susceptible to dehydration, so it can't spend too much time on land.

pokemon.Name: Lopunny
pokemon.Pokedex: It swings its ears like whips and strikes its enemies with them. It has an intensely combative disposition.

pokemon.Name: Garchomp

pokemon.Name: Lucario
pokemon.Pokedex: It readies itself to face its enemies by focusing its mental energies. Its fighting style can be summed up in a single word: heartless.

pokemon.Name: Abomasnow
pokemon.Pokedex: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

pokemon.Name: Gallade
pokemon.Pokedex: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

pokemon.Name: Rotom

pokemon.Name: Rotom

pokemon.Name: Rotom

pokemon.Name: Rotom

pokemon.Name: Rotom

pokemon.Name: Giratina

pokemon.Name: Shaymin

pokemon.Name: Aegislash
pokemon.Pokedex: Once upon a time, a king with an Aegislash reigned over the land. His Pokémon eventually drained him of life, and his kingdom fell with him.

pokemon.Name: Pumpkaboo
pokemon.Pokedex: Spirits that wander this world are placed into Pumpkaboo's body. They're then moved on to the afterlife.

pokemon.Name: Gourgeist

pokemon.Name: Xerneas
pokemon.Pokedex: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

pokemon.Name: Zygarde

pokemon.Name: Diancie

pokemon.Name: Hoopa

pokemon.Name: Oricorio
pokemon.Pokedex: It creates an electric charge by rubbing its feathers together. It dances over to its enemies and delivers shocking electrical punches.

pokemon.Name: Oricorio
pokemon.Pokedex: This Oricorio relaxes by swaying gently. This increases its psychic energy, which it then fires at its enemies.

pokemon.Name: Oricorio
pokemon.Pokedex: It summons the dead with its dreamy dancing. From their malice, it draws power with which to curse its enemies.

pokemon.Name: Lycanroc

pokemon.Name: Lycanroc

pokemon.Pokedex: Weak Wishiwashi school together to concentrate their power. Their united force makes them the demon of the sea, feared near and far.

pokemon.Name: Necrozma
pokemon.Pokedex: This is Necrozma's form while it's absorbing the power of Solgaleo, making it extremely ferocious and impossible to control.

pokemon.Name: Necrozma
pokemon.Pokedex: Lunala no longer has a will of its own. Now under the control of Necrozma, it continuously expels all of its energy.

pokemon.Name: Necrozma
pokemon.Pokedex: The light pouring out from all over its body affects living things and nature, impacting them in various ways.

pokemon.Name: Necrozma
pokemon.Pokedex: Light is apparently the source of its energy. It has an extraordinarily vicious disposition and is constantly firing off laser beams.

pokemon.Name: Magearna
pokemon.Pokedex: This gorgeous Magearna looks as it did at the time of its invention. Its luxurious decoration pleased the king's daughter.

pokemon.Name: Cramorant
pokemon.Pokedex: Cramorant's gluttony led it to try to swallow an Arrokuda whole, which in turn led to Cramorant getting an Arrokuda stuck in its throat.

pokemon.Name: Cramorant
pokemon.Pokedex: This Cramorant has accidentally gotten a Pikachu lodged in its gullet. Cramorant is choking a little, but it isn't really bothered.

pokemon.Name: Toxtricity
pokemon.Pokedex: Capable of generating 15,000 volts of electricity, this Pokémon looks down on all that would challenge it.

pokemon.Name: Sinistea
pokemon.Pokedex: The swirl pattern in this Pokémon's body is its weakness. If it gets stirred, the swirl loses its shape, and Sinistea gets dizzy.

pokemon.Name: Polteageist
pokemon.Pokedex: Trainers Polteageist trusts will be allowed to experience its distinctive flavor and aroma firsthand by sampling just a tiny bit of its tea.

pokemon.Name: Eiscue
pokemon.Pokedex: The ice covering this Pokémon's face has shattered, revealing a slightly worried expression that many people are enamored with.

pokemon.Name: Indeedee
pokemon.Pokedex: They diligently serve people and Pokémon so they can gather feelings of gratitude. The females are particularly good at babysitting.

pokemon.Name: Morpeko
pokemon.Pokedex: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

pokemon.Name: Zacian
pokemon.Pokedex: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

pokemon.Name: Zamazenta
pokemon.Pokedex: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

pokemon.Name: Urshifu
pokemon.Pokedex: It's believed that this Pokémon modeled its fighting style on the flow of a river—sometimes rapid, sometimes calm.

pokemon.Name: Calyrex
pokemon.Pokedex: According to lore, this Pokémon showed no mercy to those who got in its way, yet it would heal its opponents' wounds after battle.

pokemon.Name: Calyrex
pokemon.Pokedex: Legend says that by using its power to see all events from past to future, this Pokémon saved the creatures of a forest from a meteorite strike.

pokemon.Name: Growlithe
pokemon.Pokedex: They patrol their territory in pairs. The igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

pokemon.Name: Arcanine
pokemon.Pokedex: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase.

pokemon.Name: Voltorb
pokemon.Pokedex: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly.

pokemon.Name: Electrode
pokemon.Pokedex: The surface tissue of its body is oddly similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon looses an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

pokemon.Name: Tauros
pokemon.Pokedex: This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed, is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and its fierce disposition.

pokemon.Name: Tauros
pokemon.Pokedex: People call this kind of Tauros the Blaze Breed due to the hot air it snorts from its nostrils. Its three tails are intertwined.

pokemon.Name: Tauros
pokemon.Pokedex: It swims by jetting water from its horns. The most notable characteristic of the Aqua Breed is its high body fat, which allows it to float easily.

pokemon.Name: Typhlosion
pokemon.Pokedex: Said to purify forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. Its form may have been influenced by the energy of a sacred mountain.

pokemon.Name: Wooper
pokemon.Pokedex: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

pokemon.Name: Qwilfish
pokemon.Pokedex: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

pokemon.Name: Sneasel
pokemon.Pokedex: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of caught prey.

pokemon.Name: Dialga
pokemon.Pokedex: Radiant light caused Dialga to take on a form bearing a striking resemblance to the creator Pokémon. Dialga now wields colossal strength.

pokemon.Name: Palkia
pokemon.Pokedex: It soars across the sky in a form that greatly resembles the creator of all things. This imitation of appearance may be its attempt to gain Arceus's powers.

pokemon.Name: Samurott
pokemon.Pokedex: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott's turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

pokemon.Name: Lilligant
pokemon.Pokedex: Its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

pokemon.Name: Basculin
pokemon.Pokedex: They live in frigid seas, forming schools and sharing food among themselves. When the time comes, they return to the river they were born in.

pokemon.Name: Basculin
pokemon.Pokedex: They live in frigid seas, forming schools and sharing food among themselves. When the time comes, they return to the river they were born in.

pokemon.Name: Zorua
pokemon.Pokedex: A once-departed soul, returned to life. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

pokemon.Name: Zoroark
pokemon.Pokedex: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with an intense bitter energy.

pokemon.Name: Braviary
pokemon.Pokedex: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any floating prey.

pokemon.Name: Sliggoo
pokemon.Pokedex: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

pokemon.Name: Goodra
pokemon.Pokedex: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

pokemon.Name: Avalugg
pokemon.Pokedex: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths.

pokemon.Name: Decidueye
pokemon.Pokedex: Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

pokemon.Name: Ursaluna
pokemon.Pokedex: This special Ursaluna can see in the dark with its left eye and protects itself with mud that is as hard as iron.

pokemon.Name: Basculegion
pokemon.Pokedex: It can afflict a target with terrifying illusions that are under its control. The deeper the sadness in its friends' souls, the paler Basculegion becomes.

pokemon.Name: Enamorus
pokemon.Pokedex: A different guise from its feminine humanoid form. From the clouds, it descends upon those who treat any form of life with disrespect and punishes them.

pokemon.Name: Oinkologne
pokemon.Pokedex: This is a meticulous Pokémon that likes to keep things tidy. It shrouds itself in a floral aroma that soothes the Pokémon around it.

pokemon.Name: Dudunsparce
pokemon.Pokedex: The gentle Dudunsparce will put Pokémon that wander into its nest onto its back and carry them to the entrance.

pokemon.Name: Palafin
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

pokemon.Name: Maushold
pokemon.Pokedex: The little one just appeared one day. They all live together like a family, but the relationship between the three is still unclear.

pokemon.Name: Revavroom
pokemon.Pokedex: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

pokemon.Name: Tatsugiri
pokemon.Pokedex: This species’ differing colors and patterns are apparently the result of Tatsugiri changing itself to suit the preferences of the prey it lures in.

pokemon.Name: Tatsugiri
pokemon.Pokedex: Bird Pokémon are its main prey. This Pokémon knows it’s weak, so it hunts with a partner.

pokemon.Name: Squawkabilly
pokemon.Pokedex: Blue-feathered Squawkabilly view their green- feathered counterparts as rivals, since the latter make up the largest, most powerful groups.

pokemon.Name: Squawkabilly
pokemon.Pokedex: The yellow Squawkabilly are especially fierce. They've even been known to drive other bird Pokémon out of town.

pokemon.Name: Squawkabilly
pokemon.Pokedex: Though these Squawkabilly are the fewest in number, they have no trouble living in towns since they blend in with the white buildings.

pokemon.Name: Gimmighoul
pokemon.Pokedex: It wanders around, carrying an old coin on its back. It survives by draining the life-force from humans who try to pick up its coin.

pokemon.Name: Poltchageist
pokemon.Pokedex: It sprinkles some of its powdery body onto food and drains the life-force from those who so much as lick it.

pokemon.Name: Sinistcha
pokemon.Pokedex: It lives inside a superb teacup that was crafted by a potter of great renown. Collectors positively adore this Pokémon.

pokemon.Name: Ogerpon
pokemon.Pokedex: This form excels in both attack and defense. It ceaselessly unleashes moves like a spring gushes water.

pokemon.Name: Ogerpon
pokemon.Pokedex: This form is the most aggressive, bombarding enemies with the intensity of flames blazing within a hearth.

pokemon.Name: Ogerpon
pokemon.Pokedex: This form has excellent defenses, absorbing impacts solidly like the cornerstones that support houses.

pokemon.Name: Ogerpon
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

pokemon.Pokedex: The shell is made of crystallized Terastal energy. When struck by a move, this shell absorbs the move’s energy and transfers it to Terapagos.

pokemon.Name: Terapagos
pokemon.Pokedex: In this form, Terapagos resembles the world as the ancients saw it, and its Terastal energy is abnormally amplified.

pokemon.Name: Raichu
pokemon.Pokedex: It resembles an X as it flies through the air with 50 million volts of electricity sparking from its ears and forked tail.

pokemon.Name: Raichu
pokemon.Pokedex: It fires bolts of electricity from the tip of its tail and from the spiky tufts of fur growing out of its temples. This electricity forms the letter Y.

pokemon.Name: Clefable
pokemon.Pokedex: It flies by using the power of moonlight to control gravity within a radius of over 32 feet around it.

pokemon.Name: Victreebel
pokemon.Pokedex: The volume of this Pokémon's acid has increased due to Mega Evolution, filling its mouth. If it's not careful, the acid will overflow and spill out.

pokemon.Name: Starmie
pokemon.Pokedex: Its movements have become more humanlike. Whether it's simply trying to communicate or wants to supplant humanity is unclear.

pokemon.Name: Dragonite
pokemon.Pokedex: Mega Evolution has excessively powered up this Pokémon's feelings of kindness. It finishes off its opponents with mercy in its heart.

pokemon.Name: Meganium
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon can fire a tremendously powerful Solar Beam from its four flowers. Another name for this is Mega Sol Cannon.

pokemon.Name: Feraligatr
pokemon.Pokedex: With its arms and hoodlike fin, this Pokémon forms a gigantic set of jaws with a bite 10 times as powerful as Mega Feraligatr's actual jaws.

pokemon.Name: Skarmory
pokemon.Pokedex: It flies faster than the speed of sound. After whipping up shock waves to send enemies flying, it finishes them off with its talons.

pokemon.Name: Chimecho
pokemon.Pokedex: It vibrates its entire body to attack in all directions using sound waves. Any who hear the vibrations get so confused, they forget who they are.

pokemon.Name: Absol
pokemon.Pokedex: Using fur that it has made into sharp, clawlike shapes, it cuts down foes with a single blow. This is an act of kindness to keep them from suffering.

pokemon.Name: Staraptor
pokemon.Pokedex: Mega Staraptor is a top-class flier. It can easily soar through the sky while gripping a Steelix that weighs more than 880 lbs.

pokemon.Name: Garchomp
pokemon.Pokedex: Garchomp has gained a new Mega-Evolved form. It flies around foes at Mach speed and cuts them to shreds with its sinister wing claws.

pokemon.Name: Lucario
pokemon.Pokedex: By completely cloaking itself in its aura, Mega Lucario Z can parry all manner of attacks, battling as if it were gracefully dancing.

pokemon.Name: Froslass
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon can use eerie cold air imbued with ghost energy to freeze even insubstantial things, such as flames or the wind.

pokemon.Name: Heatran
pokemon.Pokedex: It's said that if it goes all out, it can heat its body up to temperatures over 1.8 million degrees Fahrenheit. This heat keeps enemies at bay.

pokemon.Name: Darkrai
pokemon.Pokedex: Its dark power blocks out the sun, plunging the surrounding area into darkness. There is no escaping its evil eye.

pokemon.Name: Emboar
pokemon.Pokedex: Brandishing a blazing flame shaped like a serpentine spear, it rushes in to rescue its imperiled allies.

pokemon.Name: Excadrill
pokemon.Pokedex: If this Pokémon brings its arms and head together to form a streamlined shape and spins at high speeds, it can destroy anything.

pokemon.Name: Scolipede
pokemon.Pokedex: Its deadly venom gives off a faint glow. The venom affects Scolipede's mind, honing its viciousness.

pokemon.Name: Scrafty
pokemon.Pokedex: Mega Evolution has caused Scrafty's shed skin to turn white, growing tough and supple. Of course, this Pokémon is still as feisty as ever.

pokemon.Name: Eelektross
pokemon.Pokedex: It now generates 10 times the electricity it did before Mega Evolving. It discharges this electricity from its false Eelektrik, which are made of mucus.

pokemon.Name: Chandelure
pokemon.Pokedex: One of its eyes is a window linking our world with the afterlife. This Pokémon draws in hatred and converts it into power.

pokemon.Name: Golurk
pokemon.Pokedex: The energy within Golurk has been stimulated by Mega Evolution. The Pokémon could explode at any moment.

pokemon.Name: Chesnaught
pokemon.Pokedex: It has fortified armor and a will to defend at all costs. Both are absurdly strong.

pokemon.Name: Delphox
pokemon.Pokedex: It wields flaming branches to dazzle its opponents before incinerating them with a huge fireball.

pokemon.Name: Greninja
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon spins a giant shuriken at high speed to make it float, then clings to it upside down to catch opponents unawares.

pokemon.Name: Pyroar
pokemon.Pokedex: This Pokémon spews flames hotter than 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. It swings around its grand, blazing mane as it protects its allies.

pokemon.Name: Floette
pokemon.Pokedex: The Eternal Flower has absorbed all the energy from Mega Evolution. The flower now attacks enemies on its own.

pokemon.Name: Meowstic
pokemon.Pokedex: Mega Meowstic can use its psychic power to compress or expand anything. It overwhelms foes by contorting space itself.

pokemon.Name: Meowstic
pokemon.Pokedex: Revealing the eyelike patterns on the insides of its ears will unleash its psychic powers. It normally keeps the patterns hidden, however.

pokemon.Name: Malamar
pokemon.Pokedex: It uses its colorful lights to overwrite the personalities and memories of others - and to control them.

pokemon.Name: Barbaracle
pokemon.Pokedex: It uses its many arms to toy with its opponents. This keeps the head extremely busy.

pokemon.Name: Dragalge
pokemon.Pokedex: It spits a liquid that causes the regenerative power of cells to run wild. The liquid is deadly poison to everything other than itself.

pokemon.Name: Hawlucha
pokemon.Pokedex: Mega Evolution has pumped up all its muscles. Hawlucha flexes to show off its strength.

pokemon.Name: Zygarde
pokemon.Pokedex: In response to people's emotions during an unprecedented crisis, Zygarde Mega Evolves and calms the situation with its unmatched power.

pokemon.Name: Zygarde
pokemon.Pokedex: It's thought to be monitoring the ecosystem. There are rumors that even greater power lies hidden within it.

pokemon.Name: Crabominable
pokemon.Pokedex: It can pulverize reinforced concrete with a light swing of one of its fists, each of which is covered in a thick layer of ice.

pokemon.Name: Golisopod
pokemon.Pokedex: It uses four of its arms to fiercely assail its foes. Once they've been pushed to the brink of defeat, it finishes them off with the arms it kept hidden.

pokemon.Name: Drampa
pokemon.Pokedex: Drampa's cells have been invigorated, allowing it to regain its youth. It manipulates the atmosphere to summon storms.

pokemon.Name: Magearna
pokemon.Pokedex: This is Magearna once a previously hidden mode activates. The emotions Magearna had begun to feel now hide away as it fells foe after foe.

pokemon.Name: Magearna
pokemon.Pokedex: A mechanism to remove Magerna's limitations has lain secretly with Magerna for 500 years. This mechanism is triggered by a Mega Stone.

pokemon.Name: Zeraora
pokemon.Pokedex: It stores up 10 lightning strikes' worth of electricity. When it stops limiting itself, it's in the strongest class of electric Pokémon.

pokemon.Name: Falinks
pokemon.Pokedex: Mega Falinks has taken on the ultimate battle formation, which can be achieved only if the troopers and brass have the strongest of bonds.

pokemon.Name: Scovillain
pokemon.Pokedex: Mega Evolution has dialed up this Pokémon's spiciness. It swings its "necktie" around to wallop its foes.

pokemon.Name: Glimmora
pokemon.Pokedex: Glimmora's petals-now larger and separated from its main body-rotate around it to provide defense while scattering poisonous fragments.

pokemon.Name: Tatsugiri
pokemon.Pokedex: Tatsugiri's brain has been invigorated by Mega Evolution, making it even wilier. It can create and command copies of itself.

pokemon.Name: Tatsugiri
pokemon.Pokedex: It solidifies the energy of Mega Evolution, building up an overflowing pile to launch as projectiles. These projectiles explode on contact.

pokemon.Name: Tatsugiri
pokemon.Pokedex: Using the energy of Mega Evolution, it creates a dish to ride upon, allowing it to move with total freedom-even through the air.

pokemon.Name: Baxcalibur
pokemon.Pokedex: Baxcalibur's dorsal blade has grown even more massive thanks to Mega Evolution. This Pokémon fires beams from the hilt at its solar plexus.

pokemon.Name: Doduo
pokemon.Pokedex: Their humps are slightly larger than their counterparts which they use to store water inside. This water freezes which causes Numels body temperature to drop.

pokemon.Name: Dodrio
pokemon.Pokedex: Their humps are slightly larger than their counterparts which they use to store water inside. This water freezes which causes Numels body temperature to drop.

pokemon.Name: Numel
pokemon.Pokedex: Their humps are slightly larger than their counterparts which they use to store water inside. This water freezes which causes Numels body temperature to drop.

pokemon.Name: Camerupt
pokemon.Pokedex: The lava inside its body has solidified and unable to be expelled, causing its humps to grow larger and sharper. They are known to cause avalanches when threatened.

pokemon.Name: Rotom
pokemon.Pokedex: The lava inside its body has solidified and unable to be expelled, causing its humps to grow larger and sharper. They are known to cause avalanches when threatened.

pokemon.Name: Conkeldurr
pokemon.Pokedex: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. They know moves that enable them to swing the pillars freely in battle.

pokemon.Name: Mienfoo
pokemon.Pokedex: Their humps are slightly larger than their counterparts which they use to store water inside. This water freezes which causes Numels body temperature to drop.

pokemon.Name: Mienshao
pokemon.Pokedex: The lava inside its body has solidified and unable to be expelled, causing its humps to grow larger and sharper. They are known to cause avalanches when threatened.

pokemon.Name: Tentacruel
pokemon.Pokedex: In order to support its flower, which has grown larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs have become stronger.

pokemon.Name: Rapidash
pokemon.Pokedex: In order to support its flower, which has grown larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs have become stronger.

pokemon.Name: Kingdra
pokemon.Pokedex: In order to support its flower, which has grown larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs have become stronger.

pokemon.Name: Vespiquen
pokemon.Pokedex: In order to support its flower, which has grown larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs have become stronger.

pokemon.Name: Machamp
pokemon.Pokedex: In order to support its flower, which has grown larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs have become stronger.

pokemon.Name: Torterra
pokemon.Pokedex: Its mighty footsteps shake the earth, awakening dormant seeds beneath the lush forest on its back.

pokemon.Name: Infernape
pokemon.Pokedex: It races into battle on a fiery cloud, spinning its blazing staff to engulf foes in searing flames.

pokemon.Name: Empoleon
pokemon.Pokedex: Its golden steel blades cleave icebergs with ease. A single regal cry makes its entire colony bow.

pokemon.Name: Kricketune
pokemon.Pokedex: In order to support its flower, which has grown larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs have become stronger.

pokemon.Name: Roserade
pokemon.Pokedex: In order to support its flower, which has grown larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs have become stronger.

pokemon.Name: Cofagrigus
pokemon.Pokedex: The lava inside its body has solidified and unable to be expelled, causing its humps to grow larger and sharper. They are known to cause avalanches when threatened.

pokemon.Name: Eternatus
pokemon.Pokedex: Infinite amounts of energy pour from this Pokémon's enlarged core, warping the surrounding space-time.

pokemon.Name: Pikachu
pokemon.Pokedex: The cap this Pikachu wears is filled with memories of this Pokémon and its partner traveling across lots of different regions together.

pokemon.Name: Pikachu
pokemon.Pokedex: The cap this Pikachu wears is filled with memories of this Pokémon and its partner traveling across the Hoenn region together.

pokemon.Name: Pikachu
pokemon.Pokedex: The cap this Pikachu wears is filled with memories of this Pokémon and its partner traveling across the Sinnoh region together.

pokemon.Name: Pikachu
pokemon.Pokedex: The cap this Pikachu wears is filled with memories of this Pokémon traveling together with its partner, whom it met in a fateful encounter.

pokemon.Name: Pikachu
pokemon.Pokedex: The cap this Pikachu wears is filled with memories of this Pokémon and its partner traveling across the world together.

moves.Name: Megahorn
moves.Description: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

moves.Name: Attack Order
moves.Description: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the target. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.Name: Bug Buzz
moves.Description: The user vibrates its wings to generate a sound wave. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.Name: First Impression
moves.Description: Although this move has great power, it only works the first turn the user is in battle.

moves.Name: Pollen Puff
moves.Description: Fires an exploding pollen puff at enemies, or a HP-restoring one at allies.

moves.Name: Leech Life
moves.Description: The user drains the target's blood. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.Name: Lunge
moves.Description: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.Name: X-Scissor
moves.Description: The user slashes at the foe by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

moves.Name: Signal Beam
moves.Description: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. It may also confuse the target.

moves.Name: Skitter Smack
moves.Description: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.Name: U-turn
moves.Description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.Name: Steamroller
moves.Description: The user crushes its foes by rolling over them. This attack may make the target flinch.

moves.Name: Bug Bite
moves.Description: The user bites the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

moves.Name: Silver Wind
moves.Description: The foe is attacked with powdery scales blown by wind. It may also raise all the user's stats.

moves.Name: Fell Stinger
moves.Description: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user's Attack stat rises drastically.

moves.Name: Struggle Bug
moves.Description: While resisting, the user attacks the opposing Pokémon. The targets' Sp. Atk stat is reduced.

moves.Name: Fury Cutter
moves.Description: The target is slashed with scythes or claws. Its power increases if it hits in succession.

moves.Name: Pin Missile
moves.Description: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

moves.Name: Twineedle
moves.Description: The foe is stabbed twice by a pair of stingers. It may also poison the target.

moves.Name: Infestation
moves.Description: The target is infested and unable to flee for four to five turns.

moves.Name: Defend Order
moves.Description: The user calls out its underlings to shield its body, raising its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

moves.Name: Heal Order
moves.Description: The user calls out its underlings to heal it. The user regains up to half of its max HP.

moves.Name: Powder
moves.Description: The target is covered in a powder that explodes and damages it if it uses a Fire-type move.

moves.Name: Quiver Dance
moves.Description: The user performs a beautiful dance. It boosts the user's Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.

moves.Name: Rage Powder
moves.Description: The user scatters irritating powder to draw attention to itself. Opponents aim only at the user.

moves.Name: Spider Web
moves.Description: The user ensnares the target with thin, gooey silk so it can't flee from battle.

moves.Name: Sticky Web
moves.Description: Weaves a sticky net around the opposing team, which lowers their Speed stats upon switching in.

moves.Name: String Shot
moves.Description: The foe is bound with silk blown from the user's mouth. This silk reduces the target's Speed.

moves.Name: Tail Glow
moves.Description: The user stares at flashing lights to focus its mind, drastically raising its Sp. Atk stat.

moves.Name: Hyperspace Fury
moves.Description: Unleashes a barrage of multi-arm attacks, skipping protections. The user's Defense stat falls.

moves.Name: Foul Play
moves.Description: The user turns the foe's power against it. It does more damage the higher the target's Attack stat.

moves.Name: Fiery Wrath
moves.Description: The user transforms its wrath into a fire-like aura to attack. This may also make foes flinch.

moves.Name: Darkest Lariat
moves.Description: The user swings both arms and hits the target. Ignores the target's stat changes.

moves.Name: Night Daze
moves.Description: The user lets loose a pitch-black shock wave at its target. It may also lower the target's accuracy.

moves.Name: Crunch
moves.Description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. It may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.Name: Dark Pulse
moves.Description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.Name: False Surrender
moves.Description: The user pretends to bow its head, but then it stabs the target with its disheveled hair. Never misses.

moves.Name: Jaw Lock
moves.Description: This move prevents the user and the target from switching out until either of them faints.

moves.Name: Throat Chop
moves.Description: The user attacks the target's throat. The target cannot use sound-based moves for two turns.

moves.Name: Wicked Blow
moves.Description: Strikes with a fierce blow through mastery of the Dark style. Always results in a critical hit.

moves.Name: Lash Out
moves.Description: The user lashes out to vent its frustration. Power is doubled if its stats dropped this turn.

moves.Name: Night Slash
moves.Description: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.Name: Sucker Punch
moves.Description: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the target is not readying an attack, however.

moves.Name: Knock Off
moves.Description: The user slaps down the target's held item, preventing that item from being used in the battle.

moves.Name: Assurance
moves.Description: If the target has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack's power is doubled.

moves.Name: Bite
moves.Description: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. It may make the target flinch.

moves.Name: Brutal Swing
moves.Description: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.

moves.Name: Feint Attack
moves.Description: The user draws up to the foe disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. It hits without fail.

moves.Name: Thief
moves.Description: The user attacks and steals the foe's held item simultaneously. It can't steal if the user holds an item.

moves.Name: Snarl
moves.Description: The user yells as if it is ranting about something, making the target's Sp. Atk stat decrease.

moves.Name: Payback
moves.Description: If the user moves after the target, this attack's power will be doubled.

moves.Name: Pursuit
moves.Description: An attack move that inflicts double damage if used on a target that is switching out of battle.

moves.Name: Beat Up
moves.Description: The user gets all the party Pokémon to attack the foe. The more party Pokémon, the more damage.

moves.Name: Fling
moves.Description: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

moves.Name: Power Trip
moves.Description: The user boasts of its strength. Power increases the more the user's stats are raised.

moves.Name: Punishment
moves.Description: This attack's power increases the more the target has powered up with stat changes.

moves.Name: Dark Void
moves.Description: Opposing Pokémon are dragged into a world of total darkness that makes them sleep.

moves.Name: Embargo
moves.Description: It prevents the target from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

moves.Name: Fake Tears
moves.Description: The user feigns crying to fluster the target, harshly lowering its Sp. Def stat.

moves.Name: Flatter
moves.Description: Flattery is used to confuse the target. However, it also raises the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.Name: Hone Claws
moves.Description: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.

moves.Name: Memento
moves.Description: The user faints when using this move. In return, it harshly lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk.

moves.Name: Nasty Plot
moves.Description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. It sharply raises the user's Sp. Atk.

moves.Name: Obstruct
moves.Description: The user protects itself from all attacks. Direct contact lowers the attacker's Defense.

moves.Name: Parting Shot
moves.Description: With a parting threat, the user lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats. Then it switches out.

moves.Name: Quash
moves.Description: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.

moves.Name: Snatch
moves.Description: The user steals the effects of any healing or stat-changing move the foe attempts to use.

moves.Name: Switcheroo
moves.Description: The user trades held items with the target faster than the eye can follow.

moves.Name: Taunt
moves.Description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

moves.Name: Topsy-Turvy
moves.Description: All stat changes affecting the target turn topsy-turvy and become the opposite of what they were.

moves.Name: Torment
moves.Description: The user torments and enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

moves.Name: Eternabeam
moves.Description: This is Eternatus's most powerful attack in its original form. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.Name: Dragon Energy
moves.Description: Converts life-force into power to attack. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.

moves.Name: Roar of Time
moves.Description: The user blasts the target with power that distorts even time. The user must rest on the next turn.

moves.Name: Draco Meteor
moves.Description: Comets are summoned down from the sky. The attack's recoil harshly reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.Name: Outrage
moves.Description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused, however.

moves.Name: Clanging Scales
moves.Description: The user rubs its scales and makes a huge noise. Also lowers the user's Defense stat.

moves.Name: Core Enforcer
moves.Description: If the target has already moved this turn, the effect of its Ability is negated.

moves.Name: Dragon Rush
moves.Description: The user tackles the foe while exhibiting overwhelming menace. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.Name: Dynamax Cannon
moves.Description: The user unleashes a strong beam from its core.

moves.Name: Spacial Rend
moves.Description: The user tears the target along with the space around it. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.Name: Dragon Hammer
moves.Description: The user uses its body like a hammer to attack the target and inflict damage.

moves.Name: Dragon Pulse
moves.Description: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.

moves.Name: Dragon Claw
moves.Description: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws.

moves.Name: Breaking Swipe
moves.Description: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks all foes. This also lowers their Attack stats.

moves.Name: Dragon Breath
moves.Description: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.Name: Dragon Tail
moves.Description: The user knocks away the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

moves.Name: Dragon Darts
moves.Description: The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two targets, this move hits each one once.

moves.Name: Dual Chop
moves.Description: The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.

moves.Name: Twister
moves.Description: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at the opposing team. It may also make targets flinch.

moves.Name: Scale Shot
moves.Description: Attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. Boosts the user's Speed but lowers its Defense.

moves.Name: Dragon Rage
moves.Description: This attack hits the target with a shock wave of pure rage. This attack always inflicts 40 HP damage.

moves.Name: Clangorous Soul
moves.Description: The user raises all its stats by using some of its HP.

moves.Name: Dragon Dance
moves.Description: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.

moves.Name: Bolt Strike
moves.Description: The user charges at its foe, surrounding itself with lightning. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

moves.Name: Volt Tackle
moves.Description: The user electrifies itself, then charges at the foe. It causes considerable damage to the user as well.

moves.Name: Zap Cannon
moves.Description: The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and cause paralysis.

moves.Name: Aura Wheel
moves.Description: Morpeko attacks and raises its Speed with energy stored in its cheeks. Type changes with the user's form.

moves.Name: Thunder
moves.Description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

moves.Name: Fusion Bolt
moves.Description: The user throws down a giant thunderbolt. It does more damage if influenced by an enormous flame.

moves.Name: Plasma Fists
moves.Description: The user attacks with electrically charged fists. Normal-type moves become Electric-type.

moves.Name: Thunderbolt
moves.Description: A strong electric blast is loosed at the target. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.Name: Wild Charge
moves.Description: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its foe. It also damages the user a little.

moves.Name: Bolt Beak
moves.Description: Stabs the target with an electrified beak. Power is doubled if the user attacks first.

moves.Name: Discharge
moves.Description: A flare of electricity is loosed to strike the area around the user. It may also cause paralysis.

moves.Name: Overdrive
moves.Description: The user attacks all foes by twanging a guitar or bass guitar, causing a huge echo and strong vibration.

moves.Name: Thunder Cage
moves.Description: The user traps the target in a cage of sparking electricity for four to five turns.

moves.Name: Zing Zap
moves.Description: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.Name: Thunder Punch
moves.Description: The target is punched with an electrified fist. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.Name: Rising Voltage
moves.Description: The user attacks with electric voltage rising from the ground. Power is doubled on Electric Terrain.

moves.Name: Volt Switch
moves.Description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.Name: Parabolic Charge
moves.Description: The user attacks everything around it. The user's HP is restored by half the damage dealt.

moves.Name: Spark
moves.Description: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the target. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.Name: Thunder Fang
moves.Description: The user bites with electrified fangs. It may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.

moves.Name: Shock Wave
moves.Description: The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.

moves.Name: Electroweb
moves.Description: The user captures and attacks foes by using an electric net, which lowers their Speed stat.

moves.Name: Charge Beam
moves.Description: The user fires a concentrated bundle of electricity. It may also raise the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.Name: Thunder Shock
moves.Description: A jolt of electricity is hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.Name: Nuzzle
moves.Description: The user nuzzles its electrified cheeks against the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.

moves.Name: Electro Ball
moves.Description: The user hurls an electric orb at the foe. It does more damage the faster the user is.

moves.Name: Charge
moves.Description: The user boosts the power of the Electric move it uses next. It also raises the user's Sp. Def stat.

moves.Name: Eerie Impulse
moves.Description: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. Harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.Name: Electric Terrain
moves.Description: The user electrifies the ground for five turns. Pokémon on the ground no longer fall asleep.

moves.Name: Electrify
moves.Description: If the target uses a move after being electrified, that move becomes Electric-type.

moves.Name: Ion Deluge
moves.Description: The user disperses electrically charged particles. Normal-type moves become Electric-type.

moves.Name: Magnet Rise
moves.Description: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.

moves.Name: Magnetic Flux
moves.Description: Manipulates magnetic fields to raise the Defense and Sp. Def stats of allies with Plus or Minus Abilities.

moves.Name: Thunder Wave
moves.Description: A weak electric charge is launched at the target. It causes paralysis if it hits.

moves.Name: Light of Ruin
moves.Description: Fires a powerful beam of light drawn from the Eternal Flower. It also damages the user a lot.

moves.Name: Fleur Cannon
moves.Description: The user unleashes a strong beam. The attack's recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.Name: Misty Explosion
