moves.Name: Mud Shot
moves.Description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. It also reduces the target's Speed.

moves.Name: Bonemerang
moves.Description: The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops to hit the target twice, coming and going.

moves.Name: Sand Tomb
moves.Description: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm for four to five turns.

moves.Name: Bone Rush
moves.Description: The user strikes the target with a hard bone two to five times in a row.

moves.Name: Mud-Slap
moves.Description: The user hurls mud in the target's face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.Name: Fissure
moves.Description: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the foe in. The target instantly faints if it hits.

moves.Name: Magnitude
moves.Description: The user looses a ground-shaking quake affecting everyone around the user. Its power varies.

moves.Name: Mud Sport
moves.Description: The user covers itself with mud. It weakens Electric-type moves while the user is in the battle.

moves.Name: Rototiller
moves.Description: The user tills the soil to encourage plant growth. This raises the Attack and Sp. Atk of Grass types.

moves.Name: Sand Attack
moves.Description: Sand is hurled in the target's face, reducing its accuracy.

moves.Name: Shore Up
moves.Description: The user regains up to half of its max HP. It restores more HP in a sandstorm.

moves.Name: Spikes
moves.Description: The user lays a trap of spikes at the foe's feet. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

moves.Name: Freeze Shock
moves.Description: On the second turn, the user hits the foe with electrically charged ice. It may also paralyze the foe.

moves.Name: Ice Burn
moves.Description: On the second turn, an ultracold, freezing wind surrounds the foe. This may leave it with a burn.

moves.Name: Glacial Lance
moves.Description: The user attacks by hurling a blizzard-cloaked icicle lance at opposing Pokémon.

moves.Name: Blizzard
moves.Description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the opposing team. It may also freeze them solid.

moves.Name: Ice Hammer
moves.Description: The user swings and hits with its strong, heavy fist. It lowers the user's Speed, however.

moves.Name: Ice Beam
moves.Description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.

moves.Name: Icicle Crash
moves.Description: The user attacks by harshly dropping an icicle onto the foe. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.Name: Ice Punch
moves.Description: The target is punched with an icy fist. It may also leave the target frozen.

moves.Name: Freeze-Dry
moves.Description: The user rapidly cools the target. This may freeze the target. Is super-effective on Water types.

moves.Name: Aurora Beam
moves.Description: The target is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.

moves.Name: Glaciate
moves.Description: The user attacks by blowing freezing cold air at the foe. This attack reduces the targets' Speed stat.

moves.Name: Ice Fang
moves.Description: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. It may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.

moves.Name: Avalanche
moves.Description: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

moves.Name: Frost Breath
moves.Description: The user blows a cold breath on the target. This attack always results in a critical hit.

moves.Name: Icy Wind
moves.Description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. It also lowers the targets' Speed stat.

moves.Name: Ice Shard
moves.Description: The user flash freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This move always goes first.

moves.Name: Powder Snow
moves.Description: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. It may also freeze the targets.

moves.Name: Ice Ball
moves.Description: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

moves.Name: Icicle Spear
moves.Description: The user launches sharp icicles at the target. It strikes two to five times in a row.

moves.Name: Triple Axel
moves.Description: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.

moves.Name: Sheer Cold
moves.Description: The foe is attacked with a blast of absolute-zero cold. The target instantly faints if it hits.

moves.Name: Aurora Veil
moves.Description: This move reduces damage from attacks for five turns. This can be used only in a hailstorm.

moves.Name: Hail
moves.Description: The user summons a hail storm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except the Ice type.

moves.Name: Haze
moves.Description: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

moves.Name: Mist
moves.Description: The user cloaks its body with a white mist that prevents any of its stats from being cut for five turns.

moves.Name: Explosion
moves.Description: The user explodes to inflict damage on those around it. The user faints upon using this move.

moves.Name: Self-Destruct
moves.Description: The user blows up to inflict damage on all Pokémon in battle. The user faints upon using this move.

moves.Name: Giga Impact
moves.Description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

moves.Name: Hyper Beam
moves.Description: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

moves.Name: Boomburst
moves.Description: The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible, explosive sound.

moves.Name: Last Resort
moves.Description: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

moves.Name: Skull Bash
moves.Description: The user tucks in its head to raise its Defense in the first turn, then rams the foe on the next turn.

moves.Name: Double-Edge
moves.Description: A reckless, life-risking tackle. It also damages the user by a fairly large amount, however.

moves.Name: Head Charge
moves.Description: The user charges its head into the foe, using its powerful guard hair. The user also takes damage.

moves.Name: Mega Kick
moves.Description: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.

moves.Name: Multi-Attack
moves.Description: Cloaking itself in high energy, the user slams into the target. This move's type depends on the held memory.

moves.Name: Techno Blast
moves.Description: The user fires a beam of light at its target. The type changes depending on the Drive the user holds.

moves.Name: Thrash
moves.Description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused, however.

moves.Name: Egg Bomb
moves.Description: A large egg is hurled at the target with maximum force to inflict damage.

moves.Name: Judgment
moves.Description: The user releases countless shots of light. Its type varies with the kind of Plate the user is holding.

moves.Name: Hyper Voice
moves.Description: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.

moves.Name: Revelation Dance
moves.Description: The user attacks the target by dancing very hard. The user's type determines the type of this move.

moves.Name: Rock Climb
moves.Description: The user attacks the target by smashing into it with incredible force. It may also confuse the target.

moves.Name: Take Down
moves.Description: A reckless, full-body charge attack for slamming into the foe. It also damages the user a little.

moves.Name: Uproar
moves.Description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.

moves.Name: Body Slam
moves.Description: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. It may leave the target with paralysis.

moves.Name: Extreme Speed
moves.Description: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This attack always goes before any other move.

moves.Name: Hyper Fang
moves.Description: The user bites hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.Name: Mega Punch
moves.Description: The target is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.

moves.Name: Razor Wind
moves.Description: A two-turn attack. Blades of wind hit the foe on the second turn. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.Name: Slam
moves.Description: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, etc., to inflict damage.

moves.Name: Strength
moves.Description: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move heavy boulders.

moves.Name: Tri Attack
moves.Description: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. May also paralyze, burn, or freeze the target.

moves.Name: Crush Claw
moves.Description: The user slashes the target with hard and sharp claws. It may also lower the target's Defense.

moves.Name: Relic Song
moves.Description: An ancient song appeals to the hearts of those listening. It may also induce sleep.

moves.Name: Chip Away
moves.Description: Seeking an opening, the user strikes continually. The foe's stat changes don't affect the damage.

moves.Name: Dizzy Punch
moves.Description: The target is hit with rhythmically launched punches that may also leave it confused.

moves.Name: Facade
moves.Description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or has paralysis.

moves.Name: Headbutt
moves.Description: The user sticks out its head and attacks by charging into the foe. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.Name: Retaliate
moves.Description: Gets revenge for a fainted ally. If an ally fainted in the last turn, this attack's damage increases.

moves.Name: Secret Power
moves.Description: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user's environment.

moves.Name: Slash
moves.Description: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.Name: Smelling Salts
moves.Description: This attack inflicts double damage on a paralyzed foe. It also cures the target's paralysis, however.

moves.Name: Horn Attack
moves.Description: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.

moves.Name: Stomp
moves.Description: The target is stomped with a big foot. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.Name: Covet
moves.Description: The user endearingly approaches the target, then steals the target's held item.

moves.Name: Hidden Power
moves.Description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

moves.Name: Round
moves.Description: The user attacks with a song. Others can join in the Round and make the attack do greater damage.

moves.Name: Swift
moves.Description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the opposing team. This attack never misses.

moves.Name: Vise Grip
moves.Description: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.

moves.Name: Cut
moves.Description: The target is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.

moves.Name: Rapid Spin
moves.Description: A spin attack that raises the user's Speed and eliminates the effects of Bind, Spikes, etc.

moves.Name: Snore
moves.Description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

moves.Name: Terrain Pulse
moves.Description: Utilizes the power of the terrain to attack. This move's type and power vary with the terrain.

moves.Name: Weather Ball
moves.Description: An attack move that varies in power and type depending on the weather.

moves.Name: Echoed Voice
moves.Description: The user attacks the foe with an echoing voice. If this move is used every turn, it does greater damage.

moves.Name: Fake Out
moves.Description: An attack that hits first and makes the target flinch. It only works the first turn the user is in battle.

moves.Name: False Swipe
moves.Description: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

moves.Name: Hold Back
moves.Description: The user holds back when it attacks, and the target is left with at least 1 HP.

moves.Name: Pay Day
moves.Description: Numerous coins are hurled at the target to inflict damage. Money is earned after battle.

moves.Name: Pound
moves.Description: The target is physically pounded with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.

moves.Name: Quick Attack
moves.Description: The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.

moves.Name: Scratch
moves.Description: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.

moves.Name: Tackle
moves.Description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.Name: Double Hit
moves.Description: The user slams the target with a long tail, vines, or tentacle. The target is hit twice in a row.

moves.Name: Feint
moves.Description: An attack that hits a target using Protect or Detect. It also lifts the effects of those moves.

moves.Name: Tail Slap
moves.Description: The user attacks by striking the target with its hard tail. It hits the Pokémon two to five times in a row.

moves.Name: Rage
moves.Description: As long as this move is in use, the user's Attack rises each time the user is hit in battle.

moves.Name: Spike Cannon
moves.Description: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

moves.Name: Comet Punch
moves.Description: The target is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times in a row.

moves.Name: Fury Swipes
moves.Description: The target is raked with sharp claws or scythes for two to five times in quick succession.

moves.Name: Barrage
moves.Description: Round objects are hurled at the target to strike two to five times in a row.

moves.Name: Bind
moves.Description: Things such as long bodies or tentacles are used to bind and squeeze the foe for four to five turns.

moves.Name: Double Slap
moves.Description: The target is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times in a row.

moves.Name: Fury Attack
moves.Description: The target is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times in a row.

moves.Name: Wrap
moves.Description: A long body or vines are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

moves.Name: Constrict
moves.Description: The foe is attacked with long, creeping tentacles or vines. It may also lower the target's Speed.

moves.Name: Bide
moves.Description: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.

moves.Name: Crush Grip
moves.Description: The target is crushed with great force. The attack is more powerful the more HP the target has left.

moves.Name: Endeavor
moves.Description: An attack move that cuts down the target's HP to equal the user's HP.

moves.Name: Flail
moves.Description: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. It becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

moves.Name: Frustration
moves.Description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

moves.Name: Guillotine
moves.Description: A vicious, tearing attack with big pincers. The target will faint instantly if this attack hits.

moves.Name: Horn Drill
moves.Description: The user stabs the foe with a horn that rotates like a drill. If it hits, the target faints instantly.

moves.Name: Natural Gift
moves.Description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

moves.Name: Present
moves.Description: The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap. It restores HP sometimes, however.

moves.Name: Return
moves.Description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

moves.Name: Sonic Boom
moves.Description: The target is hit with a destructive shock wave that always inflicts 20 HP damage.

moves.Name: Spit Up
moves.Description: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released all at once in an attack.

moves.Name: Super Fang
moves.Description: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. It cuts the target's HP to half.

moves.Name: Trump Card
moves.Description: The fewer PP this move has, the greater its attack power.

moves.Name: Wring Out
moves.Description: The user powerfully wrings the foe. The more HP the foe has, the greater this attack's power.

moves.Name: Acupressure
moves.Description: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its stats.

moves.Name: After You
moves.Description: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.

moves.Name: Assist
moves.Description: The user hurriedly and randomly uses a move among those known by other Pokémon in the party.

moves.Name: Attract
moves.Description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.Name: Baton Pass
moves.Description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, passing along any stat changes.

moves.Name: Belly Drum
moves.Description: The user maximizes its Attack stat in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP.

moves.Name: Bestow
moves.Description: The user passes its held item to the target when the target isn't holding an item.

moves.Name: Block
moves.Description: The user blocks the target's way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.

moves.Name: Camouflage
moves.Description: The user's type is changed depending on its environment, such as at water's edge, in grass, or in a cave.

moves.Name: Captivate
moves.Description: Lowers Sp. Atk, more if opposite gender. Stronger on infatuated foes.

moves.Name: Celebrate
moves.Description: The Pokémon congratulates you on your special day!

moves.Name: Confide
moves.Description: The user tells the target a secret. The target loses focus and its Sp. Atk stat is lowered.

moves.Name: Conversion
moves.Description: The user changes its type to become the same type as one of its moves.

moves.Name: Conversion 2
moves.Description: The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the attack the opponent used last.

moves.Name: Copycat
moves.Description: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.

moves.Name: Court Change
moves.Description: With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on either side of the field.

moves.Name: Defense Curl
moves.Description: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.

moves.Name: Disable
moves.Description: For four turns, this move prevents the target from using the move it last used.

moves.Name: Double Team
moves.Description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

moves.Name: Encore
moves.Description: The user compels the target to keep using only the move it last used for three turns.

moves.Name: Endure
moves.Description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.Name: Entrainment
moves.Description: The user dances to compel the target to mimic it, making the target's Ability the same as the user's.

moves.Name: Flash
moves.Description: A blinding electric flash that lowers the target's accuracy.

moves.Name: Focus Energy
moves.Description: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.

moves.Name: Follow Me
moves.Description: The user draws attention to itself, making all targets take aim only at the user.

moves.Name: Foresight
moves.Description: Enables the user to hit a Ghost type with any kind of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.

moves.Name: Glare
moves.Description: The user intimidates the target with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.

moves.Name: Growl
moves.Description: The user growls in an endearing way, making the foe less wary. The foe's Attack stat is lowered.

moves.Name: Growth
moves.Description: The user's body grows all at once, raising the Atk and Sp. Atk stats.

moves.Name: Happy Hour
moves.Description: Using Happy Hour doubles the amount of prize money received after battle.

moves.Name: Harden
moves.Description: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.

moves.Name: Heal Bell
moves.Description: The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status problems of all the party Pokémon.

moves.Name: Helping Hand
moves.Description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of its attack.

moves.Name: Hold Hands
moves.Description: The user and an ally hold hands. This makes them very happy.

moves.Name: Howl
moves.Description: The user howls loudly to raise the spirit of itself and allies, boosting their Attack stats.

moves.Name: Laser Focus
moves.Description: The user focuses intensely. The attack on the next turn always results in a critical hit.

moves.Name: Leer
moves.Description: The user gains an intimidating leer with sharp eyes. The target's Defense stat is reduced.

moves.Name: Lock-On
moves.Description: The user takes sure aim at the target. It ensures the next attack does not fail to hit the target.

moves.Name: Lovely Kiss
moves.Description: With a scary face, the user tries to force a kiss on the target. If it suceeds, the target falls asleep.

moves.Name: Lucky Chant
moves.Description: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing the foe from landing critical hits.

moves.Name: Me First
moves.Description: The user tries to cut ahead of the foe to steal and use the foe's intended move with greater power.

moves.Name: Mean Look
moves.Description: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.

moves.Name: Metronome
moves.Description: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

moves.Name: Milk Drink
moves.Description: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.

moves.Name: Mimic
moves.Description: The user copies the move last used by the foe. The move can be used until the user is switched out.

moves.Name: Mind Reader
moves.Description: The user senses the foe's movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss the foe.

moves.Name: Minimize
moves.Description: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply raises its evasiveness.

moves.Name: Morning Sun
moves.Description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

moves.Name: Nature Power
moves.Description: An attack that makes use of nature's power. Its effects vary depending on the user's environment.

moves.Name: Noble Roar
moves.Description: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the target and lowers its Attack and Sp. Atk.

moves.Name: Odor Sleuth
moves.Description: Negates evasion boosts and Ghost immunity. Raises the user's Attack.

moves.Name: Pain Split
moves.Description: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then equally shares the combined HP with the target.

moves.Name: Perish Song
moves.Description: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.

moves.Name: Play Nice
moves.Description: The user and target become friends. The target loses its will to fight, lowering its Attack stat.

moves.Name: Protect
moves.Description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.Name: Psych Up
moves.Description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

moves.Name: Recover
moves.Description: Restoring its own cells, the user restores its own HP by half of its max HP.

moves.Name: Recycle
moves.Description: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

moves.Name: Reflect Type
moves.Description: The user reflects the target's type, making it the same type as the target.

moves.Name: Refresh
moves.Description: The user rests to cure itself of a poisoning, burn, or paralysis.

moves.Name: Roar
moves.Description: The target is scared off and replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

moves.Name: Safeguard
moves.Description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.

moves.Name: Scary Face
moves.Description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly reduce its Speed stat.

moves.Name: Screech
moves.Description: An earsplitting screech harshly reduces the target's Defense stat.

moves.Name: Sharpen
moves.Description: The user reduces its polygon count to make itself more jagged, raising the Attack stat.

moves.Name: Shell Smash
moves.Description: The user breaks its shell, lowering its defenses but sharply raising attacking and Speed stats.

moves.Name: Simple Beam
moves.Description: The user's mysterious psychic wave changes the target's Ability to Simple.

moves.Name: Sing
moves.Description: A soothing lullaby is sung in a calming voice that puts the target into a deep slumber.

moves.Name: Sketch
moves.Description: It enables the user to permanently learn the move last used by the foe. Once used, Sketch disappears.

moves.Name: Slack Off
moves.Description: The user slacks off, restoring its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP.

moves.Name: Sleep Talk
moves.Description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.Name: Smokescreen
moves.Description: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. It reduces the target's accuracy.

moves.Name: Soft-Boiled
moves.Description: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.

moves.Name: Splash
moves.Description: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...

moves.Name: Spotlight
moves.Description: The user shines a spotlight on the target so that only it will be attacked during the turn.

moves.Name: Stockpile
moves.Description: The user charges up power and raises both its Defense and Sp. Def. The move can be used three times.

moves.Name: Stuff Cheeks
moves.Description: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply raises its Defense stat.

moves.Name: Substitute
moves.Description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user's decoy.

moves.Name: Supersonic
moves.Description: The user generates odd sound waves from its body. It may confuse the target.

moves.Name: Swagger
moves.Description: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, it also sharply raises the target's Attack stat.

moves.Name: Swallow
moves.Description: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to heal its HP.

moves.Name: Sweet Scent
moves.Description: A sweet scent that lowers the foe's evasiveness. It also lures wild Pokémon if used in grass, etc.

moves.Name: Swords Dance
moves.Description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user's Attack stat.

moves.Name: Tail Whip
moves.Description: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary and lowering their Defense stat.

moves.Name: Tearful Look
moves.Description: Gets teary eyed to make the target lose its will to fight. Lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk.

moves.Name: Teatime
moves.Description: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon in the battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.

moves.Name: Teeter Dance
moves.Description: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses the Pokémon around it.

moves.Name: Tickle
moves.Description: The user tickles the target into laughing, reducing its Attack and Defense stats.

moves.Name: Transform
moves.Description: The user transforms into a copy of the target right down to having the same move set.

moves.Name: Whirlwind
moves.Description: The foe is blown away, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

moves.Name: Wish
moves.Description: One turn after this move is used, the target's HP is restored by half the user's maximum HP.

moves.Name: Work Up
moves.Description: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

moves.Name: Yawn
moves.Description: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.

moves.Name: Belch
moves.Description: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.

moves.Name: Gunk Shot
moves.Description: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. It may also poison the target.

moves.Name: Sludge Wave
moves.Description: It swamps the area around the user with a giant sludge wave. It may also poison those hit.

moves.Name: Shell Side Arm
moves.Description: Inflicts physical or special damage, whichever will be more effective. May also poison the target.

moves.Name: Sludge Bomb
moves.Description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.

moves.Name: Poison Jab
moves.Description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle or arm seeped with poison. It may also poison the target.

moves.Name: Cross Poison
moves.Description: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also poison the foe. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.Name: Sludge
moves.Description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.

moves.Name: Venoshock
moves.Description: The user drenches the foe in a special poisonous liquid. Its power doubles if the target is poisoned.

moves.Name: Clear Smog
moves.Description: The user attacks by throwing a clump of special mud. All status changes are returned to normal.

moves.Name: Poison Fang
moves.Description: The user bites the target with toxic fangs. It may also leave the target badly poisoned.

moves.Name: Poison Tail
moves.Description: The user hits the target with its tail. It may also poison the target. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.Name: Acid
moves.Description: The foe is attacked with a spray of harsh acid. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.Name: Acid Spray
moves.Description: The user spits fluid that works to melt the target. This harshly reduces the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.Name: Smog
moves.Description: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. It may also poison the target.

moves.Name: Poison Sting
moves.Description: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger. This may also poison the target.

moves.Name: Acid Armor
moves.Description: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply raising its Defense stat.

moves.Name: Baneful Bunker
moves.Description: Protects the user from attacks. Also poisons any attacker that makes contact with the user.

moves.Name: Coil
moves.Description: The user coils up and concentrates. This raises its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.

moves.Name: Corrosive Gas
moves.Description: The user surrounds everything around it with highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.

moves.Name: Gastro Acid
moves.Description: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the foe. The fluid negates the effect of the target's Ability.

moves.Name: Poison Gas
moves.Description: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the face of opposing Pokémon. It may poison those hit.

moves.Name: Poison Powder
moves.Description: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust on the target. It may poison the target.

moves.Name: Purify
moves.Description: The user heals the target's status condition. If so, it also restores the user's own HP.

moves.Name: Toxic
moves.Description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.Name: Toxic Spikes
moves.Description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the foe's feet. They poison foes that switch into battle.

moves.Name: Toxic Thread
moves.Description: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower the target's Speed stat.

moves.Name: Venom Drench
moves.Description: Foes are drenched in an odd liquid that lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed of poisoned Pokémon.

moves.Name: Prismatic Laser
moves.Description: The user shoots powerful lasers using the power of a prism. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.Name: Psycho Boost
moves.Description: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack's recoil harshly reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.Name: Future Sight
moves.Description: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

moves.Name: Synchronoise
moves.Description: Using an odd shock wave, the user damages any Pokémon of the same type as the user.

moves.Name: Dream Eater
moves.Description: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping foe. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user's HP.

moves.Name: Photon Geyser
moves.Description: The user attacks with a pillar of light. This move the higher of the user's Attack or Sp. Atk stat.

moves.Name: Psystrike
moves.Description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

moves.Name: Freezing Glare
moves.Description: The user shoots its psychic power from its eyes to attack. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.Name: Psychic
moves.Description: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.Name: Psychic Fangs
moves.Description: The user bites the target using psychic capabilities. This can also destroy Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.Name: Eerie Spell
moves.Description: The user attacks with tremendous psychic power. This also removes 3 PP from the target's last move.

moves.Name: Expanding Force
moves.Description: The user attacks the target with psychic power. Powers up and hits all foes on Psychic Terrain.

moves.Name: Extrasensory
moves.Description: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.Name: Hyperspace Hole
moves.Description: Using a hyperspace hole, the user appears right next to the target and strikes. Skips protections.

moves.Name: Psyshock
moves.Description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

moves.Name: Zen Headbutt
moves.Description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the foe. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.Name: Luster Purge
moves.Description: The user lets loose a damaging burst of light. It may also reduce the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.Name: Mist Ball
moves.Description: A mistlike flurry of down envelops and damages the target. It may also lower the target's Sp. Atk.

moves.Name: Psycho Cut
moves.Description: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.Name: Psybeam
moves.Description: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. It may also cause confusion.

moves.Name: Heart Stamp
moves.Description: The user unleashes a vicious blow after its cute act makes the foe less wary. It may also cause flinching.

moves.Name: Confusion
moves.Description: The target is hit by a weak telekinetic force. It may also leave the target confused.

moves.Name: Stored Power
moves.Description: The user attacks with stored power. The more the user's stats are raised, the greater the damage.

moves.Name: Mirror Coat
moves.Description: A retaliation move that counters any special attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

moves.Name: Psywave
moves.Description: The target is attacked with an odd psychic wave. The attack varies in intensity.

moves.Name: Agility
moves.Description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. It sharply boosts the Speed stat.

moves.Name: Ally Switch
moves.Description: The user switches places with an ally. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.Name: Amnesia
moves.Description: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. It sharply raises the user's Sp. Def stat.

moves.Name: Barrier
moves.Description: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.

moves.Name: Calm Mind
moves.Description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

moves.Name: Cosmic Power
moves.Description: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

moves.Name: Gravity
moves.Description: Gravity is intensified for five turns, making moves involving flying unusable and negating Levitation.

moves.Name: Guard Split
moves.Description: The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def stats with those of its target.

moves.Name: Guard Swap
moves.Description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def with the target.

moves.Name: Heal Block
moves.Description: For five turns, the foe is prevented from using any moves, Abilities, or held items that recover HP.

moves.Name: Heal Pulse
moves.Description: The user emits a healing pulse which restores the target's HP by up to half of its max HP.

moves.Name: Healing Wish
moves.Description: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status cured.

moves.Name: Heart Swap
moves.Description: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the target.

moves.Name: Hypnosis
moves.Description: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall into a deep sleep.

moves.Name: Imprison
moves.Description: If the foe knows any move also known by the user, the foe is prevented from using it.

moves.Name: Instruct
moves.Description: The user instructs the target to use the target's last move again.

moves.Name: Kinesis
moves.Description: The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. It lowers the target's accuracy.

moves.Name: Light Screen
moves.Description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.

moves.Name: Lunar Dance
moves.Description: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its status and HP fully restored.

moves.Name: Magic Coat
moves.Description: A barrier reflects back to the target moves like Leech Seed and moves that damage status.

moves.Name: Magic Powder
moves.Description: The user scatters a cloud of magic powder that changes the target to Psychic type.

moves.Name: Magic Room
moves.Description: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's held items lose their effects for five turns.

moves.Name: Meditate
moves.Description: The user meditates to awaken the power deep within its body and raise its Attack stat.

moves.Name: Miracle Eye
moves.Description: Enables the user to hit a Dark type with any type of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.

moves.Name: Power Split
moves.Description: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with those of the target.

moves.Name: Power Swap
moves.Description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk with the target.

moves.Name: Power Trick
moves.Description: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack with its Defense stat.

moves.Name: Psychic Terrain
moves.Description: Protects grounded Pokémon from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.

moves.Name: Psycho Shift
moves.Description: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status problems to the target.

moves.Name: Reflect
moves.Description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

moves.Name: Rest
moves.Description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user's HP and heals any status problem.

moves.Name: Role Play
moves.Description: The user mimics the target completely, copying the target's natural Ability.

moves.Name: Skill Swap
moves.Description: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

moves.Name: Speed Swap
moves.Description: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.

moves.Name: Telekinesis
moves.Description: The user makes the target float with its psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.

moves.Name: Teleport
moves.Description: The user switches place with a party Pokémon. Also warps to the last Pokémon Center visited.

moves.Name: Trick
moves.Description: The user catches the target off guard and swaps its held item with its own.

moves.Name: Trick Room
moves.Description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

moves.Name: Wonder Room
moves.Description: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for 5 turns.

moves.Name: Head Smash
moves.Description: The user attacks the foe with a hazardous, full-power headbutt. The user also takes terrible damage.

moves.Name: Rock Wrecker
moves.Description: The user launches a huge boulder at the target to attack. It must rest on the next turn, however.

moves.Name: Meteor Beam
moves.Description: Gathers space power and boosts its Sp. Atk stat on the first turn, attacks on the next turn.

moves.Name: Diamond Storm
moves.Description: The user whips up a storm of diamonds to damage foes. This may also sharply raise the user's Defense stat.

moves.Name: Stone Edge
moves.Description: The user stabs the foe with sharpened stones from below. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.Name: Power Gem
moves.Description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

moves.Name: Rock Slide
moves.Description: Large boulders are hurled at the foes to inflict damage. It may also make the targets flinch.

moves.Name: Ancient Power
moves.Description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user's stats at once.

moves.Name: Rock Tomb
moves.Description: Boulders are hurled at the target. It also lowers the target's Speed by preventing its movement.

moves.Name: Rock Throw
moves.Description: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to attack.

moves.Name: Smack Down
moves.Description: The user throws a stone or projectile to attack. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when hit.

moves.Name: Accelerock
moves.Description: The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.

moves.Name: Rollout
moves.Description: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

moves.Name: Rock Blast
moves.Description: The user hurls hard rocks at the target. Two to five rocks are launched in quick succession.

moves.Name: Rock Polish
moves.Description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It can sharply raise the Speed stat.

moves.Name: Sandstorm
moves.Description: Summons a five-turn sandstorm to hurt all combatants except the Rock, Ground, and Steel types.

moves.Name: Stealth Rock
moves.Description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the foe. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

moves.Name: Tar Shot
moves.Description: Pours sticky tar over the target, lowering its Speed and making it weaker to Fire-type moves.

moves.Name: Wide Guard
moves.Description: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for a turn. May fail if used in succession.

moves.Name: Doom Desire
moves.Description: Two turns after this move is used, the user blasts the target with a concentrated bundle of light.

moves.Name: Steel Beam
moves.Description: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.

moves.Name: Steel Roller
moves.Description: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails when the ground isn't a terrain.

moves.Name: Behemoth Bash
moves.Description: The user becomes a gigantic shield and slams into the target.

moves.Name: Behemoth Blade
moves.Description: The user becomes a gigantic sword and cuts the target.

moves.Name: Iron Tail
moves.Description: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. It may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.Name: Sunsteel Strike
moves.Description: The user slams into the target with the force of a meteor. Can't be stopped by the target's Ability.

moves.Name: Meteor Mash
moves.Description: The target is hit with a hard punch fired like a meteor. It may also raise the user's Attack.

moves.Name: Anchor Shot
moves.Description: The user entangles the target with its anchor chain. The target becomes unable to flee.

moves.Name: Flash Cannon
moves.Description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.Name: Iron Head
moves.Description: The foe slams the target with its steel-hard head. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.Name: Smart Strike
moves.Description: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.

moves.Name: Steel Wing
moves.Description: The target is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user's Defense stat.

moves.Name: Double Iron Bash
moves.Description: The user rotates, centering the hex nut in its chest, and then strikes twice. May cause flinching.

moves.Name: Mirror Shot
moves.Description: The user looses a flash of energy from its polished body. It may also lower the target's accuracy.

moves.Name: Magnet Bomb
moves.Description: The user launches steel bombs that stick to the target. This attack will not miss.

moves.Name: Gear Grind
moves.Description: The user attacks by throwing two steel gears at its target.

moves.Name: Metal Claw
moves.Description: The target is raked with steel claws. It may also raise the user's Attack stat.

moves.Name: Bullet Punch
moves.Description: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.

moves.Name: Gyro Ball
moves.Description: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

moves.Name: Heavy Slam
moves.Description: The user slams into the foe with its heavy body. The heavier the user, the greater the damage.

moves.Name: Metal Burst
moves.Description: The user retaliates with much greater power against the target that last inflicted damage on it.

moves.Name: Autotomize
moves.Description: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.

moves.Name: Gear Up
moves.Description: The user engages its gears to raise the Attack and Sp. Atk of allies with the Plus or Minus Ability.

moves.Name: Iron Defense
moves.Description: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

moves.Name: King's Shield
moves.Description: Protects itself from damage. It also harshly lowers the Attack of attackers that make contact.

moves.Name: Metal Sound
moves.Description: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly reduces the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.Name: Shift Gear
moves.Description: The user rotates its gears, raising its Attack and sharply raising its Speed.

moves.Name: Hydro Cannon
moves.Description: The target is hit with a watery blast. The user must rest on the next turn, however.

moves.Name: Water Spout
moves.Description: The user spouts water to damage the foe. The lower the user's HP, the less powerful it becomes.

moves.Name: Hydro Pump
moves.Description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

moves.Name: Origin Pulse
moves.Description: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with countless beams of light that glow a deep and brilliant blue.

moves.Name: Steam Eruption
moves.Description: The user immerses the target in superheated steam. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.Name: Crabhammer
moves.Description: The target is hammered with a large pincer. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.Name: Aqua Tail
moves.Description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

moves.Name: Muddy Water
moves.Description: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at the opposing team. It may also lower the target's accuracy.

moves.Name: Sparkling Aria
moves.Description: The user bursts into song, emitting many bubbles. Any burnt Pokémon will be healed by these bubbles.

moves.Name: Surf
moves.Description: It swamps the area around the user with a giant wave. It can also be used for crossing water.

moves.Name: Fishious Rend
moves.Description: The user rends the target with its hard gills. Power doubles if the user moves first.

moves.Name: Liquidation
moves.Description: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. May lower the target's Defense.

moves.Name: Dive
moves.Description: Diving on the first turn, the user rises and hits on the next turn. It can be used to dive in the ocean.

moves.Name: Scald
moves.Description: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. It may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.Name: Snipe Shot
moves.Description: The user ignores any effects that redirect moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.

moves.Name: Water Pledge
moves.Description: A column of water strikes the target. When combined with its fire equivalent, it makes a rainbow.

moves.Name: Waterfall
moves.Description: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.

moves.Name: Razor Shell
moves.Description: The user cuts the foe with sharp shells. It may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.Name: Brine
moves.Description: If the target's HP is down to about half, this attack will hit with double the power.

moves.Name: Bubble Beam
moves.Description: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the target. It may also lower its Speed stat.

moves.Name: Octazooka
moves.Description: The user attacks by spraying ink in the foe's face or eyes. It may also lower the target's accuracy.

moves.Name: Flip Turn
moves.Description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.Name: Water Pulse
moves.Description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the target.

moves.Name: Aqua Jet
moves.Description: The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.

moves.Name: Bubble
moves.Description: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the opposing team. It may also lower the targets' Speed stats.

moves.Name: Water Gun
moves.Description: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

moves.Name: Clamp
moves.Description: The target is clamped and squeezed by the user's very thick and sturdy shell for four to five turns.

moves.Name: Whirlpool
moves.Description: Traps foes in a violent swirling whirlpool for four to five turns.

moves.Name: Surging Strikes
moves.Description: Hits three times in a row with mastery of the Water style. This attack always deals critical hits.

moves.Name: Water Shuriken
moves.Description: The user hits the target with throwing stars 2-5 times in a row. This move always goes first.

moves.Name: Aqua Ring
moves.Description: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP on every turn.

moves.Name: Life Dew
moves.Description: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores the HP of itself and its allies.

moves.Name: Rain Dance
moves.Description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves.

moves.Name: Soak
moves.Description: The user shoots a torrent of water at the target and changes the target's type to Water.

moves.Name: Water Sport
moves.Description: The user soaks itself with water. The move weakens Fire-type moves while the user is in the battle.

moves.Name: Withdraw
moves.Description: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.

moves.Name: Dire Claw
moves.Description: The user may critically hit with its ruinous claws. May also leave the target poisoned, paralyzed, or asleep.

moves.Name: Springtide Storm
moves.Description: The user wraps winds of fierce emotion around opponents. This may lower their Attack stats.

moves.Name: Raging Fury
moves.Description: The user rampages around spewing flames for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

moves.Name: Wave Crash
moves.Description: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target. This also damages the user.

moves.Name: Chloroblast
moves.Description: The user launches its amassed chlorophyll to inflict damage on the target. This also damages the user.

moves.Name: Mountain Gale
moves.Description: The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the target. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.Name: Headlong Rush
moves.Description: The user rams into the target in a full-body tackle. This lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

moves.Name: Barb Barrage
moves.Description: Fires toxic barbs which may poison the target. Power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

moves.Name: Esper Wing
moves.Description: The user slashes with aura-enriched wings which boosts its Speed stat. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.Name: Bitter Malice
moves.Description: The user attacks the target with spine-chilling resentment. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

moves.Name: Triple Arrows
moves.Description: The user fires arrows which may lower the target’s Defense or make it flinch. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.Name: Bleakwind Storm
moves.Description: The user attacks with cold winds that cause opposing Pokémon to tremble. This may lower their Speed stats.

moves.Name: Wildbolt Storm
moves.Description: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with a thunderous tempest. This may also leave them paralyzed.

moves.Name: Sandsear Storm
moves.Description: The user wraps fierce winds and hot sand around opponents. This may leave them with a burn.

moves.Name: Lunar Blessing
moves.Description: The user is blessed by the moon, restoring HP and curing status conditions of itself and allies.

moves.Name: Psyshield Bash
moves.Description: Cloaking itself in psychic energy, the user slams into the target. This raises the user’s Defense.

moves.Name: Power Shift
moves.Description: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats.

moves.Name: Stone Axe
moves.Description: The user swings at the opponent with its stone axes. May leave floating rocks around the target.

moves.Name: Mystical Power
moves.Description: The user attacks by emitting a mysterious power. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.Name: Victory Dance
moves.Description: The user performs an intense dance to usher in victory, raising its Attack, Defense, and Speed.

moves.Name: Shelter
moves.Description: The user makes its skin as hard as an iron shield, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

moves.Name: Infernal Parade
moves.Description: Hurls fireballs which may cause burns. Power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

moves.Name: Ceaseless Edge
moves.Description: The user slashes the opponent with its shell blade. May leave spikes around the target.

moves.Name: Take Heart
moves.Description: The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions and boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

moves.Name: Aqua Cutter
moves.Description: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.Name: Aqua Step
moves.Description: The user attacks the target using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user’s Speed stat.

moves.Name: Armor Cannon
moves.Description: The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles. This lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def.

moves.Name: Axe Kick
moves.Description: Performs a downward kick which may confuse the target. The user takes damage if it misses.

moves.Name: Bitter Blade
moves.Description: A spiteful slashing attack. The user’s HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

moves.Name: Blazing Torque
moves.Description: This move is only used by a Starmobile. It may leave the target with a burn.

moves.Name: Chilling Water
moves.Description: The user showers the target with frigid water. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.Name: Chilly Reception
moves.Description: The user tells a chillingly bad joke and switches out. This summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.

moves.Name: Collision Course
moves.Description: A massive prehistoric explosion. This move’s power is boosted more than usual if it’s a supereffective hit.

moves.Name: Combat Torque
moves.Description: This move is only used by a Starmobile. It may paralyze the target.

moves.Name: Comeuppance
moves.Description: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.

moves.Name: Doodle
moves.Description: The user captures a quick sketch, changing the Abilities of the user and its allies to the target's.

moves.Name: Double Shock
moves.Description: The user attacks by discharging all of its electricity. The user will no longer be Electric type.

moves.Name: Electro Drift
moves.Description: A futuristic electric strike. This move’s power is boosted more than usual if it’s a supereffective hit.

moves.Name: Fillet Away
moves.Description: The user sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats by using its own HP.

moves.Name: Flower Trick
moves.Description: The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target, which always hits and lands a critical hit.

moves.Name: Gigaton Hammer
moves.Description: The user attacks with its huge hammer. This move can’t be used twice in a row.

moves.Name: Glaive Rush
moves.Description: The user becomes highly vulnerable to attacks until its next turn after using this move.

moves.Name: Hyper Drill
moves.Description: The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed to pierce the target, ignoring protections.

moves.Name: Ice Spinner
moves.Description: The user spins into the target with feet covered in thin ice. This also destroys the terrain.

moves.Name: Jet Punch
moves.Description: The user summons a torrent around its fist and punches at blinding speed. Always goes first.

moves.Name: Kowtow Cleave
moves.Description: The user kowtows to make the target lower its guard, then slashes. This attack never misses.

moves.Name: Last Respects
moves.Description: The user attacks to avenge its allies. The move’s power increases for each defeated ally.

moves.Name: Lumina Crash
moves.Description: The user attacks by unleashing a peculiar, mind-bending light that harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Def.

moves.Name: Magical Torque
moves.Description: This move is only used by a Starmobile. It may confuse the target.

moves.Name: Make It Rain

items.Description: The user vibrates its wings to generate a damaging sound wave. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

items.Name: TM163
items.Description: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

items.Name: TM164
items.Description: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. The user also takes serious damage.

items.Name: TM165
items.Description: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the foe. The user also takes damage and may burn the target.

items.Name: TM166
items.Description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

items.Name: TM167
items.Description: The user fights the foe up close without guarding itself. It also cuts the user's Defense and Sp. Def.

items.Name: TM168
items.Description: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

items.Name: TM169
items.Description: Comets are summoned down from the sky. The attack's recoil harshly reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

items.Name: TM170
items.Description: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.

items.Name: TM172
items.Description: The target is scared off and replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

items.Name: TM173
items.Description: The user boosts the power of the Electric move it uses next. It also raises the user's Sp. Def stat.

items.Name: TM174
items.Description: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

items.Name: TM175
items.Description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

items.Name: TM176
items.Description: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm for four to five turns.

items.Name: TM177
items.Description: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

items.Name: TM178
items.Description: Gravity is intensified for five turns, making moves involving flying unusable and negating Levitation.

items.Name: TM179
items.Description: The user throws a stone or projectile to attack. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when hit.

items.Name: TM180
items.Description: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

items.Name: TM181
items.Description: The user slaps down the target's held item, preventing that item from being used in the battle.

items.Name: TM182
items.Description: The user bites the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

items.Name: TM183
items.Description: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. It cuts the target's HP to half.

items.Name: TM184
items.Description: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.

items.Name: TM185
items.Description: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This lowers the target's Attack stat.

items.Name: TM186
items.Description: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

items.Name: TM187
items.Description: The user launches sharp icicles at the target. It strikes two to five times in a row.

items.Name: TM188
items.Description: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. It may also leave the target with a burn.

items.Name: TM189
items.Description: The user slams the foe with its flaming body. The heavier the user is, the greater the damage.

items.Name: TM190
items.Description: The user gathers light energy into a blade, attacking the target on the next turn.

items.Name: TM191
items.Description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.

items.Name: TM192
items.Description: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. It will fail if the user is hit before it is used.

items.Name: TM193
items.Description: This move's type and power change depending on the weather at the time the move is used.

items.Name: TM194
items.Description: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.

items.Name: TM195
items.Description: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This burns all foes that had their stats boosted this turn.

items.Name: TM196
items.Description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

items.Name: TM197
items.Description: The user slams the target with its wings. The target is hit twice in a row.

items.Name: TM198
items.Description: Attacks the target by controlling its item. The move fails if the target doesn't have an item.

items.Name: TM199
items.Description: The user lashes out to vent its frustration. Power is doubled if its stats dropped this turn.

items.Name: TM200
items.Description: Attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. Boosts the user's Speed but lowers its Defense.

items.Name: TM201
items.Description: The user attacks everything around and faints upon using this move. Power increases on Misty Terrain.

items.Name: TM202
items.Description: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then equally shares the combined HP with the target.

items.Name: TM203
items.Description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

items.Name: TM204
items.Description: A reckless, life-risking tackle. It also damages the user by a fairly large amount, however.

items.Name: TM205
items.Description: An attack move that cuts down the target's HP to equal the user's HP.

items.Name: TM206
items.Description: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and attacks everything around it.

items.Name: TM207
items.Description: The user attacks driven by frustration. Power increases if the user's previous move failed.

items.Name: TM208
items.Description: Traps foes in a violent swirling whirlpool for four to five turns.

items.Name: TM209
items.Description: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at the opposing team. It may also lower the target's accuracy.

items.Name: TM210
items.Description: The user drops onto the target with its electrified body. If it misses, the user is hurt instead.

items.Name: TM211
items.Description: The user captures and attacks foes by using an electric net, which lowers their Speed stat.

items.Name: TM212
items.Description: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.

items.Name: TM213
items.Description: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.

items.Name: TM214
items.Description: It swamps the area around the user with a giant sludge wave. It may also poison those hit.

items.Name: TM215
items.Description: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This may also burn the target.

items.Name: TM216
items.Description: The user covers the target's body with a mass of down that harshly lowers its Attack stat.

items.Name: TM217
items.Description: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

items.Name: TM218
items.Description: The user attacks the target with psychic power. Powers up and hits all foes on Psychic Terrain.

items.Name: TM219
items.Description: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

items.Name: TM220
items.Description: Gathers space power and boosts its Sp. Atk stat on the first turn, attacks on the next turn.

items.Name: TM221
items.Description: The user attacks the target's throat. The target cannot use sound-based moves for two turns.

items.Name: TM222
items.Description: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks all foes. This also lowers their Attack stats.

items.Name: TM223
items.Description: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly reduces the target's Sp. Def stat.

items.Name: TM224
items.Description: A move that works differently for the Ghost type than for all the other types.

items.Name: TM225
items.Description: The target is crushed with great force. The attack is more powerful the more HP the target has left.

items.Name: TM226
items.Description: The user raises its allies’ critical hit ratio with a draconic cry. This rouses Dragon types more.

items.Name: TM227
items.Description: Attacks using an angelic voice. This confuses the target if its stats have been raised this turn.

items.Name: TM228
items.Description: Attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. Prevents the target from healing for two turns.

items.Name: TM229
items.Description: An attack that hits first and makes the target flinch. Fails if the target isn't using a high priority move.

items.Name: Innate Shuffler
items.Description: Re-randomizes the innate abilities of a pokemon. Good luck!

items.Name: Dynamax Band
items.Description: A Wishing Star has been affixed to it. It lets out light that allows Pokémon to Dynamax when at a Power Spot.

items.Name: Wishing Star
items.Description: A stone that radiates Dynamax energy. It can fully recharge your Dynamax Band in battle.

items.Name: Dynamax Candy
items.Description: Raises the Dynamax Level of a single Pokémon by one. A higher level means higher HP when Dynamaxed.

items.Name: Dynamax Candy XL
items.Description: Maxes out the Dynamax Level of a single Pokémon. A higher level means higher HP when Dynamaxed.

items.Name: Max Soup
items.Description: A soup that packs a huge kick. Certain Pokémon that consume it may be given the ability to Gigantamax.

items.Description: A mysterious Poké Ball that contains a random Pokémon.

items.Name: Great Ball
items.Description: A mysterious Great Ball with better odds for rare Pokémon.

items.Description: A mysterious Ultra Ball with high odds for rare Pokémon.

items.Name: Master Ball
items.Description: A mysterious Master Ball with the best odds for rare Pokémon.

items.Name: Torterite

items.Name: Amaze Mulch
